# Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst

## Location

United Kingdom

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

GTM

OverviewApplication

***1Password is growing.** We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.*

**About 1Password**

*At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.*

*If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.*

We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst to help build and scale 1Password’s Commercial Deal Desk capability within Revenue Operations. You’ll partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams on complex commercial decisions, while turning what you learn into clear processes, guidance, and tools that help teams move faster with confidence. This role will help strengthen 1Password’s enterprise commercial capabilities as deal complexity and volume grow.

**How we’re using AI today**

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

**What we're looking for:**

* 4+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Commercial Finance, or a related function within a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Salesforce Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ)/Revenue Cloud, including resolving complex quoting and cross-object issues.
* Strong understanding of commercial deal structures, including annual recurring revenue (ARR), multi-year agreements, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, stub billing, bundled products, and discounting.
* Demonstrated ability to build or improve processes, documentation, approval workflows, and commercial policies in an evolving environment.
* Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer and seller needs with pricing discipline, revenue integrity, and business risk.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to influence effectively without formal authority and explain complex commercial concepts clearly.
* Experience using artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or workflow tools to reduce manual work and improve the quote-to-cash process is preferred.

**What you can expect:**

* Partner with Enterprise Account Executives (AEs), Sales Managers, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on complex, non-standard, and high-impact deals.
* Advise on deal structure, pricing, terms, discounting, approvals, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, bundled products, and other commercial considerations.
* Review and execute deal submissions in Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, ensuring quotes and contracts are accurate, complete, and ready for approval and invoicing.
* Build the foundations of the Commercial Deal Desk, including intake processes, approval routing, discount governance, exception handling, service-level agreements (SLAs), and documentation.
* Create playbooks, training materials, office hours, and practical guidance that help sales teams navigate commercial processes and quoting tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI tooling, and CPQ configuration, while partnering with technical teams to implement scalable solutions.
* Use deal data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify bottlenecks, improve deal quality, and recommend changes that support efficient, sustainable growth.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £60,000 GBP and £84,000 GBP, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.  
  
At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.  
  
*This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

**Our culture**   
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.   
  
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, *1Password is not for everyone*. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.   
  
**How we work with AI**  
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.  
  
  
**Our approach to work**  
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.  
  
For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.  
  
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.   
  
  
**What we offer**  
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:   
  
*Health and wellbeing*  
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs  
🩺 Competitive health benefits  
🏝 Generous PTO policy   
  
 *Growth and future*   
📈 RSU program for most employees  
💸 Retirement matching program  
🔑 Free 1Password account  
  
*Community*   
🤝 Paid volunteer days   
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly  
🌎 Remote-first work environment  
*\*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.*

**You belong here.**

*1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.*

*Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.*

*Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.*

*Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.*

* 6+ years in a customer-facing, consultative, or technical role in SaaS – Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, or IT/security leadership.
* Demonstrated track record of exceeding retention, adoption, and expansion outcomes; experience recognized with performance distinction is a plus.
* Proven ability to run executive business reviews with VP and C-suite stakeholders.
* Background in cybersecurity, IAM, identity security, or enterprise IT preferred; former 1Password power user is a strong plus.

* Strategic success planning and multi-threaded stakeholder management across a complex portfolio.
* Commercial acumen: independently qualifies, advances, and documents expansion opportunities; manages negotiations without oversight.
* Designs and applies AI-assisted workflows to commercial execution; documents use cases in a shareable format.
* Strong Gainsight and Salesforce hygiene; consistent forecasting discipline.

* Highly autonomous; manages complex accounts without requiring managerial direction.
* Commercial thinker who connects customer outcomes to expansion potential naturally.
* Strong executive presence – adapts messaging across technical, operational, and C-suite audiences.
* Elevates teammates through knowledge sharing and informal mentorship.

**What you can expect:**

### **Own and Grow Your Book of Business**

* Independently manage a portfolio of moderately to highly complex accounts – adapting success plans to each customer’s context without manager guidance.
* Maintain full success plan coverage; produce documented best practices and playbooks, applied broadly across accounts with measurable KPI improvement.
* Proactively identify and mitigate renewal risks; close risk CTAs with a high rate of success within defined timeframes.

### **Drive Adoption & Value Realization**

* Achieve strong Executive Sponsor attendance in EBRs across segments; EBRs are value-driven, data-backed, and consistently advance renewal confidence.
* Maintain commercial intelligence across strategic accounts – budget cycles, org changes, compliance mandates, and stack rationalization.
* Translate advanced 1Password capabilities into clear outcomes for VP and C-suite stakeholders; tie adoption to measurable ROI and long-term advocacy.

### **Lead Revenue Retention & Expansion**

* Achieve strong amendment and renewal upsell win rates; proactively source and advance expansion opportunities with documented context.
* Maintain forecasting hygiene with minimal blank or unmodified renewals approaching subscription end.

### **Operate with Strategic Rigor**

* Manage commercial objections, renewal negotiations, and competitive conversations independently – without escalation for standard to complex scenarios.
* Build and present business cases to customer champions; advance deals with enough depth to move through the pipeline with AE alignment.

### **Act as a Trusted Security Advisor**

* Deep working knowledge of the full 1Password product suite; design tailored success journeys connecting feature adoption to measurable business outcomes.
* Incorporate regulatory context, breach patterns, and competitive dynamics into EBRs with confidence.
* Design and share AI-assisted workflows with teammates in a replicable, documented format.

### **Collaborate & Enable**

* Lead joint account planning with your AE; cited by AEs as a proactive commercial collaborator who improves deal outcomes.
* Mentor Level B CSMs through call shadowing, ad hoc coaching, or onboarding support.
* Lead or co-lead cross-team initiatives; contribute tools or improvements adopted by peers.

### **Month 1 – Onboarding & Foundation**

* Develop fluency in 1Password’s full product suite, CS methodology, and commercial motion.
* By the end of Month 1, you will independently manage customer touchpoints and demonstrate clear understanding of renewal drivers across your portfolio.

### **Month 3 – Portfolio Ownership**

* Full ownership of your book with consistent EBR cadence and expansion sourcing.
* By Month 3, you are meeting key performance targets and expansion leads are flowing to Sales with documented context.

### **Month 6 – Strategic Impact**

* Operating at full commercial autonomy; contributing to team practices and mentoring peers.
* By Month 6, you are achieving top-tier customer satisfaction and recognized as a reliable commercial collaborator by your AE and cross-functional partners.

job_description:
About 1st Formations
At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.
Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled — freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.
We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.
No stitched-together services. 
No legacy workflows disguised as software.
Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.
Why Join Us Now?
You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.
£18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR
Over 1 million companies formed
Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business
Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years
The Role

# DESIGN MANAGER / SENIOR DESIGN ENGINEER £50,000.00-£60,000.00 per year

Bring fresh eyes to the future of CNC engineering.

Blackman & White is looking for an experienced Design Manager/Senior Design Engineer to bring fresh thinking, new ideas and a critical eye to our manufacturing design and engineering technology.

This is a hands-on opportunity to shape the next generation of our CNC cutting machinery, combining mechanical design, project leadership and team development. You’ll take projects from concept through design, prototyping, testing and production, while challenging existing approaches and identifying opportunities to improve our products, processes and engineering standards.

Work with a talented team collaborating across production, procurement, suppliers & customers, you’ll have genuine influence over how we design & manufacture.

If you’re an experienced engineer who enjoys solving problems, questioning “the way we’ve always done it” & turning ideas into production-ready solutions, we’d love your fresh pair of eyes.

We are looking for an experienced Design Manager / Senior Design Engineer to lead & deliver the design of our CNC cutting machinery. This is a senior, hands-on role combining engineering design, project management & team leadership. You will take projects from initial concept through design, manufacture, testing & production release, while leading & developing the Design Team. We are an established UK manufacturer of CNC cutting systems, designing & manufacturing innovative machinery from our facility in Heybridge, Essex.

Key responsibilities  
Lead, mentor & develop the internal Design Team  
Manage multiple engineering projects from concept to production release  
Remain hands-on with detailed mechanical & engineering design  
Produce & review 3D models, assemblies & production drawings using SolidWorks  
Ensure designs are robust, cost-effective & optimised for manufacture  
Manage prototyping, testing & engineering changes  
Coordinate external design consultancies & subcontract engineers  
Work closely with Production, Procurement, suppliers & customers  
Ensure projects meet agreed technical, cost, quality & delivery targets  
Drive continuous improvement in products & manufacturing processes

You will have substantial senior-level experience in engineering design & manufacturing, with a proven ability to deliver production-ready designs.  
Strong SolidWorks capability  
Experience managing engineering projects from concept through manufacture & testing  
Knowledge of multiple manufacturing & tooling techniques  
Experience across mechanical & electrical engineering  
Good understanding of production, procurement & supply chain  
Strong commercial awareness around design cost & manufacturability  
Experience leading & mentoring engineers.  
Strong communication & stakeholder-management skills.

**Production Engineering Manager**

**Skelmersdale**

**Up to £60,000.00 per annum DOE**

# Seasonal Stylist - Bristol Cribbs Causeway

Apply now

## The allsaints team

At AllSaints, we are in the business of feelings—making our customers feel cool and confident. Connected by attitude, creativity, and independence, we believe the wearer completes the look. Behind our effortless, character-filled designs is a global team bridging raw authenticity with high-fashion design.

Driven by Britishness as our foundation and London as our inspiration, we are entering a bold new era from September 1st, anchored by a complete brand relaunch under Creative Director Aaron Esh. Bringing a sharp, contemporary edge to our iconic aesthetic, Esh’s vision reinvents our signature pieces for a modern global audience. Grounded in substance over spectacle, we take risks, experiment, and build lifetime staples meant to be lived in, kept forever, and passed on.

Creative Director Aaron Esh says “I’m interested in character. I want people to see someone and think, ‘they are very AllSaints.’ That’s when a brand has a true identity.”

If you want to shape this next chapter, we’d love to talk.

-

Join AllSaints as a temporary Stylist this festive season during an incredible time of growth and transformation! Fueled by our brand relaunch, this is an exciting moment to enter our world. You’ll gain hands-on experience across all store operations—from styling and checkout to backstage processing—in a fun, inclusive, fashion-driven environment. Many of our leaders started right here, making this a great career springboard into our tribe.

**Key Requirements & Details:**  
**Availability:** Essential across Black Friday and the Christmas holidays.  
**What We Offer:** Full training on our brand, processes, and systems to set you up for success.  
**Who We Want:** Passionate, customer-focused team players from all backgrounds who love our sustainable products.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**  
**Elevating Customer Experience:** Deliver exceptional, personalized styling that celebrates individual style over short-lived trends. Share deep product knowledge to guide customers both in-store and backstage for digital orders, building lasting brand loyalty.  
**Driving Store Operations:** Keep the sales floor vibrant and fully stocked by managing inventory replenishment, processing new deliveries, and using digital tools to support a seamless shopping journey.  
**Maintaining Brand Standards:** Take pride in your workplace by upholding high visual merchandising standards on the shop floor while keeping staff areas clean, organized, and welcoming for the team.

## About the location

We’re excited to open our new AllSaints store at The Mall, Cribbs Causeway – the South West’s premier shopping and leisure destination. Serving a vast and affluent catchment from Bristol to South Wales, Cribbs is where the region comes for a full day out. With its mix of high-street favourites, luxury retailers, and anchor stores like John Lewis, plus year-round entertainment from cinemas to ice rinks, it attracts a broad audience of families, professionals, and style-conscious shoppers. AllSaints now joins this vibrant retail hub, bringing our signature edge to one of the UK’s most dynamic shopping locations.

**From seasonal temp to brand staple—see how our seasonal stylists turned a temporary role into a permanent career at AllSaints. Here’s what they had to say:**

Abby Hook, Bicester Village - “I started as a part time seasonal stylist at AllSaints in November 2025 and have been with the brand ever since, having recently gone full time. The team at Bicester are an absolute pleasure to work with and is one of the main reasons as to why I stayed on. We all work really well together to achieve and exceed goals.  
I have loved fashion since a young age so being able to style customers on a day-to-day basis is such an amazing feeling; especially convincing them to buy their first ever leather jacket! It’s a feel-good factor for them and also myself.”

Christopher O’Keeffe, Bicester Village - “I joined AllSaints last year as a seasonal stylist and couldn’t have found the team to be more welcoming! I really enjoyed the brand and the supportive environment, so moving into a permanent role felt like a natural next step.”

Moukthika Pinnamreddy, Covent Garden - “I really enjoyed the fast-paced environment of being a Seasonal Stylist, as it pushed me to learn quickly and keep up with the team.  
I was lucky to have an amazing team of managers and stylists who supported me throughout the journey. They were always happy to answer my questions and encourage me to push my boundaries.  
I started in womenswear and, once I became comfortable, was given the opportunity to work in menswear too. Coming back in a permanent role has allowed me to build on and refine those skills further and become more aligned with the brand. It has been a joyful experience for me.”

**WE ARE REAL LIFE, NOT RUNWAY** We design for real life, real people  
**WE DO LEATHER RIGHT** Leather is our heritage and our signature: built to be worn hard, kept forever and passed on  
**WE LEAD, WE DON’T FOLLOW** We built our reputation by doing things differently  
**WE DO QUALITY** If it’s not built to last, it’s not AllSaints  
**WE ARE HERE FOR THE LONG TERM** Because true sustainability starts with making something worth keeping  
**WE ARE THE RAMSKULL** A symbol of belonging

## Some of our benefits

* A generous wardrobe allowance so that you can wear our beautiful clothes to work each day
* Potential to earn more from our team bonus scheme
* Discount to share with family and friends
* Opportunity for permanent placement
* Free, confidential, wellbeing and lifestyle support with Retail Trust
* Dedicated mental health support from our mental health first aiders

## #WeAreAllSaints

Our aim is to develop truly diverse teams and create an environment where everyone feels respected, valued and able to give of their best whilst contributing to the success of our brand.

We recognise the importance and strength of diversity and commit to providing equal opportunities to everyone in our employment and recruitment processes. We safeguard against any form of discrimination irrespective of gender, gender reassignment, marital status, race, ethnic origin, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status or age.

Even if you feel you don’t tick all the boxes, we’d still very much like to hear from you. We want you to know that finding people who have a passion for our brand and are open to learning is incredibly important to us.

If you need any support or adjustments during your application, please get in touch with us and we are happy to help.

## The allsaints team

* Good working methods – the ability to create a well-organised work environment by means of good time management and the monitoring/checking of the accuracy of work/information.

This role will join the Global Design team, reporting to the EMEA Design Manager, and will work closely with the EMEA Design & Construction (D&C) teams, the Workplace Guidelines & Standards team and the Global Transformation & Insights team.


This role will be responsible for the oversight of the design of "post-occupancy" tenant improvement projects, which means updating, revising and evolving the design of a space where Amazonians are currently working, and small/medium new site projects (new sites) or expansions. The project scope ranges from the design of several floors of a building to suit the needs and behaviors of a new team, to the design of smaller specialty spaces, to developing an overall design solution that can improve the workplace that can be applied to multiple projects (for example, an improvement to acoustics, lighting, or furniture). Over time, this role should gain familiarity with Amazon's EMEA corporate workplace portfolio in order to pro-actively identify and recommend design solutions for certain buildings or spaces. This role will work closely with the EMEA D&C team and sub-consultants/vendors on project delivery.


The successful candidate is an experienced, and engaging professional who can communicate clearly at all levels, and yet is not afraid to dive deep into details. This role works autonomously and creatively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, and will be working on multiple projects and initiatives, most of which have very tight delivery timelines. Attention to detail and ability to inspect issues and processes brings simplified solutions to complex problems is paramount. They should also understand the nuance of being approachable, while at the same time consultative. The candidate must be able to balance frugality with creativity in offering solutions and approach problem-solving with an emphasis on root cause.


This is a Regional role focused on the EMEA region, so requires regional travel approximately 20-30% of the time. At Amazon, we also believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. - Collaborate with GREF partner teams, including Regional Portfolio Management, Sustainability and Environmental Health and Safety, and Travel and Events, to elevate program deliverables and improve the quality of Amazon workspace with a focus on resiliency, efficiency, health, and safety.

Day-to-day, this role will mainly collaborate with the EMEA Constrution team responsible for construction and delivery of projects. Are you interested in bringing new graphics and gaming technology into commercial games and game engines? This could be the role for you!

The **Game & Graphics Technology Integration (GTI)** team helps developers adopt new Arm technologies by integrating them into game engines and production workflows. The team works with technology before it reaches broad release, tests it in practical scenarios, and feeds what we learn back into the teams building it.

GTI is looking for a **Principal Software Engineer** to provide technical leadership across game-engine, graphics, and performance projects.

The role combines hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring and collaboration. Projects often begin before all the answers are known, so the work involves investigating options, building prototypes, and helping several teams agree on a practical way forward.

GTI is part of Arm’s **Strategy & Ecosystems** organisation and works with teams across graphics, machine learning, drivers, developer tools, and performance.

## Responsibilities

The Principal Software Engineer will:

* Lead game-engine investigations and integrations involving new Arm graphics and compute technologies, including work in Unreal Engine and other commercial or proprietary engines.
* Build prototypes, assess architectural options, and help determine which approaches should progress into reusable implementations.
* Analyse CPU and GPU performance, diagnose integration issues, and turn findings into clear recommendations for Arm engineering teams and partners.
* Provide technical direction across team boundaries, represent GTI in partner discussions, and mentor engineers working on related projects.

The role is expected to have impact beyond individual project delivery. This includes improving technical approaches, identifying recurring problems, sharing engineering knowledge, and helping other engineers make sound decisions independently.

## Required Skills and Experience

Strong experience in software engineering for graphics, game engines, systems software or other real-time applications is required, together with:

* Practical experience with **Vulkan** or another modern graphics API, plus strong C++ skills.
* Graphics debugging and profiling tools.
* Experience working within a **large game engine or comparable software codebase**.
* A solid understanding of GPU rendering, synchronisation, memory behaviour, and CPU/GPU performance.
* Experience leading technical work, resolving ambiguous engineering problems, and influencing decisions across teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication skill, and the ability to explain technical decisions to engineers, leaders and external partners.

Please note that this role may involve occasional travel to conferences and to our partners' offices.

## Nice to Have

Experience in some of the following areas would be useful:

* Unreal Engine, mobile graphics, Android, or Arm Mali GPUs.
* Machine learning for graphics, neural rendering, upscaling, frame generation, or development with pre-release hardware and software.

We don't expect a deep level of experience across every area. Candidates with strong game-engine or graphics expertise who are interested in learning the rest are encouraged to apply!

## About the Team

GTI works where Arm technology meets real game-development workflows.

Our current focus is supporting adoption of technologies from Arm’s **Neural Graphics Program**, alongside work in engine integration, graphics performance, tooling, and partner enablement. During the last year, we've been contributing to the development of Neural Dawn, the first mobile game that makes use of our neural graphics technology and Unreal Engine's MegaLights.

Typical tasks involve engine modifications, investigating a performance problem, testing an early software stack, maintaining and improving tooling, developing a reusable workflow, enabling our Content Team, and working directly with external developers.

Ultimately, our main goal is to make others successful by helping them integrate our technology into their projects and tech stacks.

## Job Description

Senior Software Engineer (FinOps | Digital Foundation)

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our FinOps team in London. ASOS runs a large Azure estate behind a platform used by millions of customers, and every architectural decision made across our engineering teams has a cost attached to it. FinOps exists to make that cost visible, attributable and actionable - so teams can move fast without spend quietly compounding in the background. This is engineering, not reporting: the pipelines, tooling and guardrails you build are what give hundreds of ASOS engineers a clear view of what their services cost and what to do about it.

At this level your ownership sits at the system and cross-team level. You will take ambiguous, high-impact problems, set the technical direction within them, and deliver to production with confidence. You will be a strong voice in architectural and cross-team decisions, working closely with the Engineering Lead, other Senior Engineers, and Finance to shape how ASOS understands and controls cloud cost.

In this role, you will own significant parts of our FinOps platform end to end. You'll build the cost and usage data pipelines that everything else depends on, the allocation and showback models that tell teams what is theirs, and the guardrails that keep the estate tidy by default. Alongside that, you'll work directly with Product Delivery Teams on the optimisation work itself - right-sizing, commitment strategy, architectural change - and quantify the impact so the result is provable rather than claimed.

This is a role for an engineer who finds cost a genuinely interesting engineering problem rather than an accounting one. The best cost saving is almost always the one an engineering team chooses to make, which means the job is as much about evidence, clarity and influence as it is about code. If you like building things that change how other engineers make decisions, this is the right role.

The primary customers of this team are the Product Delivery Teams across ASOS, and the measure of success is not whether we shipped a dashboard - it is whether those teams trust the numbers, act on them, and are making better architectural calls because of what we built.

Our north star is simple: any engineer at ASOS should be able to see what their services cost, understand why, and know what to do about it - without asking Finance or FinOps to find out for them. That is what we are building.

Within six months, a strong senior engineer in this team will own a meaningful part of the FinOps platform, have delivered measurable and defensible savings alongside engineering teams, and be the person other engineers come to before they make an expensive architectural decision.

What You'll Be Doing

* Design and deliver the data products that make Azure cost visible and attributable across ASOS - cost and usage pipelines, allocation and showback models, anomaly detection, and the reporting surfaces engineering and Finance actually use.

* Own the cost and usage data platform on Databricks: ingesting Azure Cost Management exports, reservation and Savings Plan data, resource inventory and tagging metadata into Delta Lake, and modelling it into datasets that engineering and Finance both trust.

* Build and own the Power BI semantic models behind cost reporting - DAX measures, composite and DirectQuery designs, and model definitions managed as code through TMDL and XMLA rather than clicked together by hand.

* Lead optimisation work across the estate - right-sizing, autoscaling behaviour, storage tiering, data transfer and egress patterns, orphaned resource cleanup - and quantify the impact so every saving is evidenced rather than asserted.

* Own our reserved capacity and Savings Plan strategy in partnership with Finance, modelling commitment scenarios against real usage patterns and the seasonal demand curves that come with retail.

* Build the guardrails that keep the estate allocatable by default - tagging and allocation policy, Azure Policy, budget controls, and exception reporting that makes unattributable spend visible - so cost hygiene does not depend on people remembering.

* Develop the unit economics that connect spend to value - cost per order, per customer, per request - so efficiency can be judged against what the business gets, not just against last month's bill.

* Engage directly with Product Delivery Teams as the primary customers of FinOps: reviewing architectures, quantifying trade-offs, and making the efficient path the easy one. This is where you will build the relationships and platform knowledge that give you real influence over what gets built next.

* Set the technical direction for FinOps engineering at ASOS - data architecture, modelling patterns and standards - and bring others with you through design review, code review and mentoring.

* Support forecasting, budgeting and variance analysis with Finance, and help explain movements in spend in terms that both engineers and Finance recognise.

* Help shape how FinOps uses agentic AI - not just adopting tools, but rethinking how cost investigation, pipeline development and reporting work when agents are part of the equation. You'll experiment with both GitHub Copilot and Claude workflows, document what you learn, and influence the team's direction.

* Write high-quality, well-tested code using a test-first approach, and work with Cyber Security to keep access standards and compliance requirements embedded by default rather than bolted on.

What We're Using

* Python - cost and usage data pipelines, modelling, automation and analysis

* Power BI - our primary surface for cost visibility: DAX, TMDL, composite and DirectQuery models, and XMLA endpoints for managing semantic models programmatically

* Databricks - Delta Lake and SQL warehouses, where our cost and usage data is processed, modelled and served

* KQL (Kusto Query Language) - querying Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and resource telemetry

* Azure - Cost Management and Billing, Advisor, Azure Policy and Monitor, plus the full breadth of services our estate actually runs on

* GitHub and GitHub Actions - source control, automation, and CI/CD

* Azure DevOps - work item tracking and pipeline management

* GitHub Copilot and Claude Code - we use both, choosing each based on the problem. Copilot for IDE-integrated agent work, Claude Code for terminal-based multi-file refactors. System context and reliability matter as much as speed.

* Beyond technical chops, we're looking for engineers with an agentic mindset. This means you see GitHub Copilot and Claude not as shortcuts, but as design partners that change how we approach problems - from investigating a cost anomaly to building the pipeline that would have caught it. If you get excited about pushing tools to new places and bringing colleagues along, this is the role.

CIB Risk Banks & Finance is responsible for assessing the credit risk of financial institutions, assigning internal ratings and defining the maximum risk appetite, both for credit and settlement risk

**About the job:**

The candidate will join a team of 10 professionals covering banks and other financial institutions. The role requires a strong understanding of financial institutions, their financial statements and risk profiles, as well as the products that generate credit and settlement exposure. Staying up to date on markets, regulation and product developments is key to supporting sound risk decisions and contributing to healthy and profitable business growth.

  

As a Financial Institutions Credit Risk Analyst, the main responsibilities of the position include:

  

* **Credit analysis and risk assessment of financial institutions**, with a primary focus on banks. This includes analyzing financial statements and key credit fundamentals, including profitability, asset quality, capital, funding and liquidity, as well as assessing the relevant industry, country, regulatory and market environment.
* **Preparation of risk proposals and definition of limits / maximum risk appetite by product**, summarized in the Financial Program, and presentation of proposals to the relevant Risk Committees. As part of this process, you will assess the individual credit profile of each institution, calculate its internal rating and determine an appropriate risk appetite across different products and types of exposure.
* **Understanding and assessment of the products and transactions generating exposure to financial institutions**, considering their specific credit and settlement risk characteristics when defining limits and risk appetite.
* **Close and regular interaction with Business**, discussing risk needs, proposed transactions and limits prior to their submission to committee. The role also involves coordination with other GRM teams across geographies and with local credit risk teams, which in turn interact with their respective local business areas.
* Participation in **cross-functional and multidisciplinary projects**, including the development and implementation of new internal rating models and initiatives aimed at introducing AI capabilities into GRM processes.

  

**What are we looking for?**

  

We are particularly interested in candidates who are already performing **similar credit risk or counterparty risk functions involving banks or other financial institutions**, and who combine strong financial analysis capabilities with a good understanding of financial products.

  

* **At least 3 years of relevant experience in Credit Risk, Counterparty Risk or a closely related function within a leading financial institution**, with direct experience analyzing banks and/or other financial institutions such as insurance companies, funds or other regulated financial entities.
* **Strong accounting and financial analysis skills are essential.** Candidates should be comfortable analyzing the financial statements of banks or other financial institutions and assessing their profitability, asset quality, capital, funding, liquidity and overall creditworthiness.
* **Good knowledge of financial products and their associated credit and settlement risks is highly valued.** In particular, candidates should be able to understand how different products and transactions translate into exposures, limits and risk appetite for financial institution counterparties.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate detailed financial, sector and product analysis into **clear credit conclusions and risk recommendations for senior decision-making and Risk Committees**.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with Business and Risk stakeholders across different products and geographies.
* University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related field. An international academic background and/or studies undertaken in English will be positively valued.
* Advanced level of English (minimum C1). Additional languages (B2 or above) will be positively valued.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Capital IQ Pro & experience using AI tools and an interest in applying them to credit risk processes will also be valued.

  

*Please note that priority will be given to candidates who are eligible to work in the UK.*

### **About the Role**

The Senior FP&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.

The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.

This is a high-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.

### **What You'll Bring**

1. **Financial Model & Accounting Foundations** — Understands the architecture of integrated three-statement and operating models and the accounting that underpins them, including SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment. Understands how the company's budgets are built and how to integrate them accurately into the core financial model.
2. **Forecasting & SaaS Unit Economics** — Understands bottom-up short-term forecasting, driver-based long-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that reveal business performance. Connects movements in those metrics to their underlying drivers and the operating levers that can change them.
3. **Mergers, Acquisitions & Integration** — Understands acquisition valuation, purchase accounting, combined-entity projections, and consolidation mechanics sufficiently to evaluate targets and integrate completed acquisitions into the financial model.
4. **Business & Commercial Acumen** — Understands in depth how the business and its functions generate revenue and incur costs, including the underlying revenue drivers, cost structure, and operating levers. Applies this knowledge to identify inconsistencies and challenge financial results and assumptions.
5. **Financial Systems & AI Tooling** — Understands Google Sheets, Excel, AI, and automation capabilities sufficiently to determine how they should be applied to financial modeling and analysis. Distinguishes where automation can improve speed and control from where financial judgment and manual validation must remain.

### **What You'll Do**

1. **Financial Model Ownership** — Builds and maintains the core three-statement and operating model using robust architecture, accounting logic, scenario and sensitivity layers, and integrated budgets, owning the accuracy of every output and the integrity of every assumption to provide reliable forecasts and analysis for company planning and decision-making.
2. **Acquisition Modeling & Integration** — Builds valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma combined-entity models by independently evaluating targets, supporting due diligence, and consolidating closed deals to provide a complete financial view of acquisition implications and the combined business.
3. **Business-Review Reporting** — Drives the financial substance of monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews with the broader FP&A team by translating model outputs and performance drivers into a clear narrative that enables senior management, the board, and investors to understand results and their implications.
4. **Metrics Analysis & Business Partnering** — Diagnoses financial and SaaS metric movements by identifying operating drivers, pressure-testing assumptions, and modeling relevant levers and downside cases to give decision-makers evidence-based recommendations they can act on.
5. **AI-Enabled Productivity** — Applies AI and spreadsheet automation to recurring financial workflows by automating appropriate work and strengthening data validation while retaining judgment over what remains manual to reduce cycle time without compromising financial integrity.

### **What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies
* A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence
* A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, an equity award aligned with long-term value creation, and comprehensive health insurance for employees and their families
* A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance

**Hours:** Full-time

We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our small team at Beyond Words and help us deliver a really varied mix of creative projects.

### About Beyond Words

Beyond Words is a creative studio that helps organisations explain complex ideas through data, information, design and storytelling.

Recent projects have covered global health, climate, science, technology, transport and public policy for clients including the World Bank, the Gates Foundation, the Global Fund, Microsoft, Netflix and Boeing. The formats are equally varied, including presentations, reports and publications, data visualisation, digital and interactive experiences, animation, exhibitions and installations.

We’re a small, collaborative team based in Brick Lane. Everyone has a voice and can contribute ideas to the work, whatever their role.

We care deeply about producing excellent work, while also creating a supportive, respectful workplace where people can do ambitious work without sacrificing their wellbeing. We choose projects and clients guided by a genuine desire to make a positive impact.

### The role

We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager who can independently lead a varied portfolio of creative projects.

You’ll typically manage 3–6 live projects at a time, ranging from fast-moving short projects to complex multi-faceted projects lasting several months.

You’ll own your projects from initial scoping through to delivery: leading multidisciplinary teams, building trusted client relationships, managing budgets and resources, anticipating risks and making sure everyone knows what needs to happen next.

### What you’ll do

#### Lead projects and creative teams

* Independently manage multiple projects from kick-off through to delivery.
* Create and maintain clear project plans, defining milestones, roles, responsibilities and dependencies.
* Run kick-offs, internal reviews and client meetings, ensuring every meeting results in clear decisions and next steps.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams including designers, data journalists, developers, animators and other creative specialists.
* Adapt plans as projects evolve, while protecting deadlines, scope and enough time for creative exploration and iteration.
* Anticipate risks and blockers, make confident day-to-day decisions and know when something needs escalating.
* Bring a strong eye for detail and quality, recognising when work is ready to present to a client and when it needs further development.

#### Build trusted client relationships

* Act as the main day-to-day client contact for your projects and build strong, collaborative relationships.
* Help translate between clients and creative teams, challenging or clarifying feedback where needed.
* Raise when requests fall outside agreed scope, timings or ways of working, while helping find practical solutions.

#### Own project documentation and resourcing

* Scope and estimate new projects.
* Create statements of work and client briefs, and maintain clear project documentation.
* Monitor team time, budgets and profitability throughout delivery.
* Identify the internal and external resources each project needs.
* Flag capacity issues early and source, brief and manage freelancers, fabricators or specialist suppliers where required.

#### Help improve how we work

* Help maintain consistently high project-management standards across the studio.
* Identify any recurring delivery issues and suggest practical improvements.
* Help evolve project-management templates, tools, estimating approaches, scoping processes and AI-assisted workflows.

### What we’re looking for

You’ll have at least four years’ experience as a Project Manager, with strong experience working in a creative/design agency or studio environment. You’ll be comfortable independently leading projects, clients and experienced creative teams.

#### You’ll also bring

* Experience managing multiple concurrent creative projects.
* Experience managing complex or multifaceted projects, particularly interactive/digital work, animation, exhibitions or installations.
* A strong understanding of the creative process, including ideation, exploration and iteration.
* The ability to brief creative teams clearly.
* Strong client-facing skills, including confidence handling senior stakeholders.
* Experience creating project plans, estimates, budgets and statements of work.
* Commercial awareness and experience monitoring time, scope and profitability.
* Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
* A proactive approach: you think ahead, follow things up and spot problems early.
* Curiosity in getting to grips with unfamiliar and sometimes complex subject matter.
* Digital confidence and an interest in exploring how AI and other tools can improve processes.
* An enthusiasm for working as part of a small, collaborative and values-led studio.

### How we work

Beyond Words is a hybrid studio. We like to spend one to two days each week together in our Brick Lane studio, with flexibility to work remotely for the remainder.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who cares about the work, is curious about the subjects we explore, enjoys collaborating closely with creative people, and shares our belief that excellent work and a healthy, respectful working culture should go hand in hand.

# Heddwas yr Heddlu - Machynlleth

## Job Introduction

## Yn Recriwtio Swyddogion Heddlu ym Machynlleth Nawr

Ymunwch â Heddlu Trafnidiaeth Prydain drwy ein Rhaglen Mynediad Cwnstabl yr Heddlu.

*"Mae Heddlu Trafnidiaeth Prydain yn wirioneddol yn heddlu unigryw gyda theimlad teuluol cryf. Rydym yn poeni'n fawr am yr hyn rydym yn ei wneud; gwasanaethu'r cyhoedd a chefnogi ein pobl. – Chris Casey, Comander Rhanbarthol Llundain a De-ddwyrain Lloegr

## Dewch yn Swyddog Heddlu yn ein Hadran C

Rydym yn recriwtio Swyddogion Heddlu ym Machynlleth.

**Mae meddu ar drwydded yrru lawn a dilys y DU yn hanfodol ar gyfer pob lleoliad a restrir yn yr hysbyseb hon.**

**Sylwer:** Rydym yn recriwtio ar gyfer y lleoliadau a nodir yn yr hysbyseb hon yn unig. Os nad yw'r lleoliadau hyn yn addas i chi, gofynnwn yn garedig ichi aros am ymgyrch recriwtio yn y dyfodol sy'n cyd-fynd yn well â'ch lleoliad dewisol.

## A allai hon fod y rôl i chi?

Fel Swyddog Heddlu gyda Heddlu Trafnidiaeth Prydain, byddwch yn chwarae rhan hanfodol wrth gadw miliynau o deithwyr, staff y rheilffyrdd ac aelodau'r cyhoedd yn ddiogel bob dydd. Gan weithio ar draws un o'r rhwydweithiau trafnidiaeth prysuraf yn y byd, byddwch yn wynebu heriau unigryw, yn datblygu sgiliau gwerthfawr ac yn gwneud gwahaniaeth gwirioneddol i fywydau pobl.

Nid oes dau ddiwrnod yr un fath. Un eiliad, gallech fod yn cefnogi person bregus mewn argyfwng. Yr eiliad nesaf, efallai y byddwch yn ymateb i argyfwng, yn ymchwilio i drosedd, yn diogelu plentyn, yn tarfu ar weithgarwch troseddol neu'n rhoi sicrwydd i rywun yn ystod un o gyfnodau mwyaf anodd eu bywyd.

Mae hon yn yrfa lle mae eich gweithredoedd yn bwysig. Mae pob rhyngweithiad yn gyfle i ddiogelu, cefnogi a chael effaith gadarnhaol ar y cymunedau rydym yn eu gwasanaethu.

Ni fyddwch byth yn wynebu'r heriau hyn ar eich pen eich hun. O'ch diwrnod cyntaf o hyfforddiant, byddwch yn cael eich cefnogi gan gydweithwyr profiadol, goruchwylwyr a mentoriaid sydd wedi ymrwymo i'ch helpu i ddatblygu, llwyddo ac adeiladu gyrfa werth chweil.

## Beth fyddwch yn ei gael yn gyfnewid

Mae gyrfa lwyddiannus ym maes plismona yn ymwneud â mwy na chyflog yn unig. Yn Heddlu Trafnidiaeth Prydain, byddwch yn elwa ar gyflog cystadleuol, buddion teithio sy'n arwain y diwydiant, polisïau cryf sy'n gyfeillgar i deuluoedd, cymorth lles cynhwysfawr a chyfleoedd parhaus i ddatblygu'n broffesiynol ac yn bersonol.

### Cyflog a Buddion

* Cyflog cychwynnol: £33,609 y flwyddyn, gan godi bob blwyddyn i £52,014 ar ôl pum mlynedd
* Cerdyn Oyster ar gyfer defnydd personol a phroffesiynol
* 25 diwrnod o wyliau blynyddol, yn cynyddu gyda gwasanaeth
* Cynllun pensiwn CARE (Career Average Revalued Earnings) hynod gystadleuol
* Cynlluniau talebau a chymhellion, gan gynnwys y cynllun beicio i'r gwaith ac ystod eang o ostyngiadau manwerthu
* Buddsoddiad parhaus mewn dysgu, gyda chefnogaeth timau talent a datblygu mewnol pwrpasol
* Cyfleoedd clir ar gyfer dyrchafiad a datblygiad gyrfa ar draws amrywiaeth o arbenigeddau plismona
* Cymorth arbenigol gan wasanaethau Iechyd Galwedigaethol a lles
* Profion golwg am ddim
* Cymhwysedd ar gyfer y Blue Light Card
* Aelodaeth o Ffederasiwn yr Heddlu o'r diwrnod cyntaf
* Cefnogaeth gref i gydbwysedd rhwng gwaith a bywyd, gan gynnwys 26 wythnos o absenoldeb mamolaeth â thâl llawn, yn ogystal ag absenoldeb tadolaeth, absenoldeb gofalwyr, absenoldeb mabwysiadu a darpariaethau absenoldeb arbennig

## Yr hyn rydym yn chwilio amdano

Nid oes angen profiad blaenorol o blismona i ymuno â ni. Rydym yn croesawu ceisiadau gan bobl o bob cefndir, profiad a chyfnod o fywyd.

P'un a ydych yn newid gyrfa, yn gadael addysg, yn dychwelyd i'r gwaith neu'n chwilio am her newydd, byddwn yn darparu'r hyfforddiant, y gefnogaeth a'r datblygiad sydd eu hangen arnoch i lwyddo. Nid oes un cefndir penodol sy'n gwneud swyddog heddlu gwych. Mae rhai o'n swyddogion yn ymuno'n syth o addysg, tra bod eraill yn dod â phrofiad gwerthfawr o yrfaoedd ym maes iechyd, gwasanaeth cwsmeriaid, manwerthu, lletygarwch, trafnidiaeth, y lluoedd arfog a llawer o broffesiynau eraill.

Yr hyn sy'n bwysig fwyaf yw eich uniondeb, eich ymrwymiad i helpu eraill a'ch parodrwydd i ddysgu. Os ydych yn poeni am bobl, yn mwynhau gweithio fel rhan o dîm ac eisiau gwneud gwahaniaeth, hoffem glywed gennych.

### Rhinweddau allweddol

* Sgiliau cyfathrebu cryf
* Barn gadarn a gallu i ddatrys problemau
* Empathi a gwydnwch emosiynol
* Y gallu i feithrin ymddiriedaeth a chadw'n dawel dan bwysau

## Rhaglen Mynediad Cwnstabl yr Heddlu (PCEP)

Bydd ymgeiswyr llwyddiannus yn ymuno â Rhaglen Mynediad Cwnstabl yr Heddlu (PCEP), sef llwybr mynediad dwy flynedd Heddlu Trafnidiaeth Prydain ar gyfer swyddogion heddlu newydd.

Nid oes angen gradd arnoch i wneud cais ac ni fydd gofyn i chi gwblhau gradd fel rhan o'r rhaglen.

Mae'r PCEP yn cyfuno dysgu yn yr ystafell ddosbarth, dysgu o bell, hyfforddiant yn seiliedig ar senarios a phrofiad gweithredol ymarferol er mwyn eich arfogi â'r wybodaeth, y sgiliau a'r ymddygiadau sydd eu hangen ar gyfer plismona rheng flaen.

### Yn ystod yr hyfforddiant, byddwch yn dysgu sut i:

* Defnyddio pwerau plismona yn gyfreithlon ac yn effeithiol
* Atal ac ymchwilio i droseddau
* Diogelu pobl fregus
* Ymateb i ddigwyddiadau ac argyfyngau
* Cefnogi dioddefwyr a thystion
* Cadw teithwyr, staff y rheilffyrdd a chymunedau lleol yn ddiogel

Wrth i'ch gyrfa ddatblygu, bydd gennych gyfleoedd i arbenigo mewn meysydd megis yr Adran Ymchwiliadau Troseddol (CID), Gwrthderfysgaeth a County Lines. P'un a ydych yn dymuno dod yn dditectif, ymuno ag uned arbenigol, datblygu fel arweinydd neu barhau i adeiladu arbenigedd mewn plismona rheng flaen, byddwn yn cefnogi eich uchelgeisiau bob cam o'r ffordd.

## Gofynion Mynediad

Er mwyn bod yn gymwys i wneud cais ar gyfer Rhaglen Mynediad Cwnstabl yr Heddlu (PCEP), rhaid i chi feddu ar y canlynol:

* Bod yn barod i gwblhau asesiad Saesneg a Mathemateg Lefel 2 HTP os nad ydych yn meddu ar y cymwysterau hyn ar hyn o bryd.

### LEFEL 3 NEU BROFIAD GWAITH

Yn ogystal â'r uchod, rhaid i chi hefyd feddu ar:

* Cymhwyster Lefel 3 neu uwch (gweler y manylion isod), **NEU**
* Brofiad gwaith perthnasol sy'n dangos lefel gyfatebol o wybodaeth, cyfrifoldeb a gallu proffesiynol (gweler y manylion isod).

### Enghreifftiau o gymwysterau Lefel 3

* Dau gymhwyster Safon Uwch ar radd E neu uwch (neu gymhwyster cyfwerth, megis BTEC Lefel 3, T Levels Lefel 3 neu'r Fagloriaeth Ryngwladol (IB))
* Diploma Cenedlaethol BTEC
* NVQ Lefel 3
* Diploma Mynediad i Addysg Uwch
* Cymwysterau Lefel 3 cydnabyddedig eraill
* Profiad mewn plismona; O leiaf 12 mis o brofiad perthnasol, gan gynnwys gwasanaeth fel: Cwnstabl Gwirfoddol Arbennig (gyda statws patrol annibynnol), Swyddog Cymorth Cymunedol yr Heddlu (PCSO), Aelod o staff yr heddlu. Rhaid bod y gwasanaeth hwn wedi'i gwblhau o fewn y pum mlynedd diwethaf.

### Neu Brofiad Gwaith

Rydym yn cydnabod mai un mesur o botensial yn unig yw cymwysterau. Os nad ydych yn meddu ar gymhwyster Lefel 3, efallai y byddwn yn ystyried profiad gwaith perthnasol fel llwybr amgen i blismona.

### Profiad gwaith perthnasol (24 mis o wasanaeth) mewn un o'r meysydd canlynol:

* Lluoedd Arfog / Gwasanaeth Milwrol
* Gwasanaethau brys (e.e. ambiwlans neu dân ac achub)
* Swyddog Diogelu Refeniw / Arolygydd Refeniw
* Swyddog Gorfodi'r Rheilffyrdd
* Rolau Ymateb i Ddigwyddiadau Rheilffyrdd neu Reoli Cyflenwi Gwasanaethau

Bydd yn ofynnol i ymgeiswyr ddarparu tystiolaeth o'u cymwysterau a/neu eu profiad yn ystod y broses recriwtio.

## Ni fyddwch yn gymwys i wneud cais os:

* Na allwch ddangos naill ai cymhwyster Lefel 3 **NEU** brofiad gwaith perthnasol sy'n gyfatebol i Lefel 3.
* Rydych wedi bod yn aflwyddiannus yn dilyn cais, prawf neu gyfweliad ar gyfer rôl Swyddog Heddlu, Cwnstabl Gwirfoddol Arbennig neu PCSO ac nad ydych wedi cwblhau'r cyfnod ailgeisio o dri mis.
* Rydych wedi cael eich gwrthod o ran fetio gan HTP neu unrhyw heddlu arall, yr NCA, y CNC neu'r MOD yn ystod y ddwy flynedd ddiwethaf.
* Rydych erioed wedi derbyn dedfryd o garchar, gan gynnwys dedfryd wedi'i gohirio.
* Rydych wedi cael eich diswyddo'n flaenorol o heddlu arall neu'n destun ymchwiliad camymddwyn gweithredol.
* Rydych yn fethdalwr, mae gennych Farn Llys Sirol (CCJ), neu Drefniant Gwirfoddol Unigol nad yw'n cael ei reoli'n briodol.
* Mae gennych datŵs sy'n cael eu hystyried yn sarhaus (caiff tatŵs ar yr wyneb a'r gwddf eu hystyried fesul achos).
* Nid oes gennych hawl barhaol i fyw a gweithio yn y DU.
* Nid ydych wedi byw yn barhaus yn y DU dros y tair blynedd diwethaf.

## Eisiau gwneud cais?

Fel rhan o'r broses, bydd gofyn i chi gwblhau Profion Barnu Sefyllfaoedd (SJT). Os na fyddwch yn llwyddo yn yr asesiadau SJT, ni fydd eich cais yn symud ymlaen ar hyn o bryd, er y gallwch ailgeisio pan fydd y cyfnod ailgeisio'n caniatáu hynny.

Fe'ch anogir, er nad yw'n ofynnol, i fynychu sesiwn cwestiynau ac atebion er mwyn dysgu mwy am y rôl, bywyd yn Heddlu Trafnidiaeth Prydain a'r broses recriwtio.

## Cydraddoldeb, Amrywiaeth a Chynhwysiant

job_description:
## Job Introduction

**Now recruiting Police Officers across the South West & Midlands**

**Join British Transport Police through our Police Constable Entry Programme.**  
  
*"BTP truly is a unique police* *force* *with a real family* *feel**. We care deeply about what we do; serving the public and* *supporting* *our people. Our work matters.* *If you want to make a positive difference to the millions of people who use the network every day, BTP is the place for you**."* **– Chris Casey, Divisional Commander, London and South East England**

**Become a Police Officer in our C Division**

We are recruiting Police Officers at **Truro, Swindon, Yeovil, Birmingham, Wolverhampton, Coventry, Milton Keynes and Leicester**  
  
**\*\* Holding a valid full UK driving licence is essential for all locations included on this advert \*\*  
  
Please note:**We are only recruiting for the locations specified in this advert. If these locations are not suitable for you, we kindly ask that you wait for a future campaign that aligns better with your preferred location.

### Could this be the role for you?

As a Police Officer with British Transport Police, you'll play a vital role in keeping millions of passengers, railway staff and members of the public safe every day. Working across one of the busiest transport networks in the world, you'll face unique challenges, develop valuable skills and make a real difference to people's lives.

No two days are the same. One moment, you could be supporting a vulnerable person in crisis. The next, you might be responding to an emergency, investigating crime, safeguarding a child, disrupting criminal activity or reassuring someone during one of the most difficult moments of their life.

This is a career where your actions matter. Every interaction provides an opportunity to protect, support and positively impact the communities we serve.

You'll never face these challenges alone. From your first day of training, you'll be supported by experienced colleagues, supervisors and mentors who are committed to helping you develop, succeed and build a rewarding career.

We offer one of the most competitive starting salary packages for Police Constables in England and Wales, alongside excellent benefits, structured career development and opportunities to specialise throughout your policing career.  
  
**What you'll get in return**

A successful policing career is about more than salary alone. At British Transport Police, you'll benefit from competitive pay, industry-leading travel benefits, strong family-friendly policies, comprehensive wellbeing support and ongoing opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.

* **Starting salary:** **£33,609**rising year-on-year to **£52,014** after five years
* **South East Allowances**: Milton Keynes attracts £3,105.00
* Oyster card for personal and professional use
* 25 days annual leave, increasing with service
* A highly competitive Career Average Revalued Earnings (CARE) pension scheme
* Voucher and incentive schemes, including cycle-to-work and a wide range of retail discounts
* Continued investment in learning, supported by dedicated in-house talent and development teams
* Clear promotion and career development opportunities across a range of policing specialisms
* Specialist support from Occupational Health and wellbeing services
* Free eyesight tests
* Eligibility for the Blue Light Card
* Membership of the Police Federation from day one
* Strong support for work-life balance, including 26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave, alongside paternity leave, carers' leave, adoption leave and special leave provisions

### What we're looking for

You do not need previous policing experience to join us. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds, experiences and stages of life.

Whether you're changing careers, leaving education, returning to work or looking for a fresh challenge, we'll provide the training, support and development you need to succeed. There is no single background that makes a great police officer. Some of our officers join directly from education, while others bring valuable experience from careers in healthcare, customer service, retail, hospitality, transportation, the military and many other professions.

What matters most is your integrity, commitment to helping others and willingness to learn. If you care about people, enjoy working as part of a team and want to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. While every day brings different challenges, successful officers are often people who communicate effectively, remain calm under pressure and can build positive relationships with people from all walks of life.

**Key qualities include:**

* Strong communication skills
* Sound judgement and problem-solving ability
* Empathy and emotional resilience
* The ability to build trust and remain calm under pressure

**Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP)**

Successful candidates will join the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), British Transport Police's two-year entry route for new police officers.

You do not need a degree to apply and you will not be required to complete a degree as part of the programme.

PCEP combines classroom learning, remote learning, scenario-based training and practical operational experience to equip you with the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed for frontline policing.

During training, you'll learn how to:

* Use policing powers lawfully and effectively
* Prevent and investigate crime
* Protect vulnerable people
* Respond to incidents and emergencies
* Support victims and witnesses
* Keep passengers, railway staff and local communities safe

As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to specialise in areas such as CID, Counter Terrorism and County Lines. Whether you aspire to become a detective, join a specialist unit, develop as a leader or continue building expertise in frontline policing, we'll support your ambitions every step of the way.

**Entry Requirements**

To be eligible to apply for the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), you must have:

**LEVEL 2**

* Level 2 qualifications in English Language and Maths (GCSE Grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent qualification), **OR**
* be willing to undertake BTP's Level 2 English and Maths assessment if you do not currently hold these qualifications,

**LEVEL 3 OR WORK EXPERIENCE**

**In addition to the above you are also required to have:**

* A Level 3 qualification or above (details below), **OR**
* Have relevant work experience demonstrating an equivalent level of knowledge, responsibility and professional capability (details below)

**Examples of Level 3 qualifications include:**

* Two A-levels at grade E or above (or equivalent, such as a BTEC Level 3, Level 3 T Levels or International Baccalaureate(IB)).
* BTEC National Diploma
* NVQ Level 3
* Access to Higher Education Diploma
* Other recognised Level 3 qualifications
* Policing experience: at least 12 months' relevant experience, including service as a Special Constable (independent patrol status), PCSO and staff. This service must have been completed within the last five years. **OR**

**Work Experience**

We recognise that qualifications are only one measure of potential. If you do not hold a Level 3 qualification, we may consider relevant work experience as an alternative route into policing.

Relevant work experience (24 months service) in one of the following areas:

* Armed Forces / Military service
* Emergency services (e.g. ambulance, fire)
* Revenue Protection Officer / Revenue Inspector
* Railway Enforcement Officer
* Rail Incident Response or Service Delivery Management roles

Candidates will be required to provide evidence of their qualifications and/or experience during the recruitment process.  
  
**You will not be eligible to apply if:**

* You cannot demonstrate either a Level 3 qualification OR relevant work experience equivalent to Level 3.
* You have been unsuccessful following your application, testing or interview for Police Officer, Special Constable or PCSO and have not yet completed the three-month reapplication period.
* You have been declined/refused vetting in the last two years by BTP or any other police force, NCA, CNC or MOD.
* You have ever received a custodial sentence, including suspended sentences.
* You have previously been dismissed from another police force or are subject to a live misconduct investigation.
* You are bankrupt, have a County Court Judgment, or an unmanaged Individual Voluntary Arrangement.
* You have tattoos deemed offensive (face and neck tattoos are considered on a case-by-case basis).
* You do not have permanent right to live and work in the UK.
* You have not resided continuously in the UK for the past three years.

### Want to apply?

Applications are completed online.

As part of the process, you will be required to complete Situational Judgement Test's. If you do not pass the SJT assessments, your application will not progress at this time, though you may reapply once the reapplication period allows.

You are encouraged, though not required, to attend a question-and-answer session to learn more about the role, life at BTP and the recruitment process.
