Company Description

  

Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.

**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**

We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.

Our global asset management business provides our clients and partners with complex, responsible investment solutions, working internationally across public and private markets.

**Who we are**

We are one of Europe’s largest asset managers and a major global investor across public and private markets.

Asset Management is a critical driver of our Group strategy. The business aims to work synergistically with our Institutional Retirement and Retail divisions to benefit our clients and customers, and deliver enhanced shareholder returns.

Our investment philosophy and processes are focused on creating value over the long term. We believe that incorporating financially material sustainability criteria, when relevant to our clients, can create value and drive positive change.

  

Job Description

  

We're looking for a Client Relationship Executive to support our Charity and Non-Profit client team, helping to deliver a high-quality service experience for existing clients while supporting new business and relationship development activities. Working closely with Client Directors and Relationship Managers, you'll play a key role in coordinating client communications, preparing materials for meetings and pitches, managing client-related administration and helping ensure client requests are handled efficiently and professionally.

This is a 12 month fixed term contract.

**What you'll be doing**

* Providing day-to-day support to Client Directors and Client Managers, working with charity and non-profit clients
* Assisting with the preparation of client presentations, pitch documents, meeting packs, reports and other supporting materials
* Supporting the coordination and resolution of client enquiries, ensuring requests are tracked and progressed in a timely manner
* Supporting client relationship management activities, including maintaining client records, coordinating reviews and preparing follow-up communications
* Coordinating logistics for client meetings, events and conference calls, including scheduling, agenda preparation and note-taking
* Supporting new business and sales activity by helping to identify opportunities, preparing proposal materials and ensuring opportunities are progressed effectively
* Working closely with colleagues across investment, operations, marketing and client service teams to gather information and deliver client requests
* Maintaining accurate records of client interactions, business development activity and key actions to support effective relationship management

**Who we're looking for**

* A strong client-service mindset with an interest in supporting charity and non-profit organisations
* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively
* Comfortable preparing presentations, reports and meeting materials with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with confidence interacting with both internal and external stakeholders
* Experience supporting client relationships or general sales support within a financial services environment
* A proactive and collaborative approach with a willingness to learn and develop
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Word
* An interest in investment management, financial services or the charity sector

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution
* Life assurance
* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‐zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‐person experience

  

Additional Information

  

At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.

If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.

We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.

It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

LEGO Digital Play will bring the LEGO brand into digital entertainment in new, innovative, and wholly-owned ways. We aim to reach every kid on the planet, their parents, and adult fans of LEGO—and provide them with meaningful, magical, and playful new experiences.
We are at the earliest phases of this new company, offering a unique opportunity to build a new entity for the world's most beloved and trusted brand. Our culture is open, collaborative, intellectually rigorous, and creatively vibrant.
Role Summary
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to lead the design and scaling of the data infrastructure that turns high-volume event and telemetry data into reliable, compliant, and queryable data, supporting product decisions, analytics, and compliance reporting.
You'll join early, build and lead the data engineering team, and set the standards others build on, while staying close to the technical work.
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead a data engineering team: hire, develop, and set technical direction for the engineers working on the data platform
Own the roadmap for data infrastructure, including evaluating and integrating third-party data sources, balancing reliability, privacy, and cost as needs grow
Design and oversee batch and streaming pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows that handle high-volume event and telemetry data reliably, idempotently, and cost-effectively, with privacy built in
Own data modelling for analytics and reporting, enabling self-serve access for product, compliance, and leadership stakeholders
Define event schemas and data contracts with backend engineers, keeping data consistent from source to warehouse
Establish data quality monitoring, testing, observability, and documentation practices across the platform
Partner with security and compliance teams to meet privacy and data protection requirements such as GDPR and COPPA, including retention and access controls
Work with infrastructure engineers on cloud deployment, infrastructure-as-code, and cost management for data workloads
Required Qualifications
Substantial experience in data engineering, with a track record of building and running production-grade pipelines at scale
A track record of leading and developing data or software engineering teams
Strong SQL skills and modern data modelling practice, including dimensional modelling
Deep familiarity with privacy by design, including working knowledge of data protection legislation, best practices, and the patterns used to implement them
Proficiency in Python or TypeScript for pipeline development
Hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g. dbt, Dataform, Airflow, Dagster)
Clear written communication for schema specifications, design docs, and stakeholder alignment.
Comfortable setting direction and making sound calls while systems and processes are still being defined
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar), Google Cloud Platform primitives in particular
Experience with streaming or event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Flink, or similar)
Experience enabling self-serve analytics through BI and semantic-layer tools (e.g. Looker/LookML, Looker Studio, Tableau)
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
Experience with game or consumer app analytics, telemetry, or attribution data
Background in games, interactive entertainment, or media

Role Summary
We are hiring a Director of Production to lead production for shared platform technology that game teams build and ship on. You will take the platform from early releases into a hardened, versioned foundation that other teams can rely on. Own planning and delivery of the platform roadmap jointly with product leadership, sequencing platform work in tune with our title pipeline
Run the release train: versioned, stable releases of SDKs, backend services, tools and reference projects
Translate product requirements and title needs into platform priorities, and platform constraints back into terms product and team leads can plan around
Establish and run the onboarding, rollout and upgrade processes for teams building on the platform
Manage dependencies on partner platform, legal, trust & safety, data and infrastructure teams
Lead third-party vendor relationships: contracts, roadmaps and escalation paths
Grow the production function as the team and the number of titles it supports grow, owning resource planning and the KPIs that go with it
Run a lightweight production process sized for a small team that ships fast, and hold every release to the highest compliance and trust & safety standards
Define and report platform delivery health metrics: time to integration, update adoption, release predictability and service availability
Required Qualifications
Experience shipping and operating live games
Substantial game production experience, including leading production for shared technology that other teams depend on
Fluency in the technical shape of the work: SDKs, backend services, cloud infrastructure and data pipelines
The aptitude and experience to evaluate technical designs, challenge sequencing calls and ask the right questions
Experience running a team whose customers are other studios or partner teams, where your output is their dependency
Experience owning third-party vendor relationships: selection, contracts, integration timelines and escalation
Clear writing: roadmaps, release notes, status and decisions in a form people outside the team can act on
Comfort being the single point of accountability for schedule, and the judgment to push back and keep scope honest
Experience partnering with product functions and the product development, and user experience design process
Preferred Qualifications
Experience shipping mobile games on iOS and Android
Experience shipping for children or family audiences, or under comparable regulation such as COPPA, GDPR-K or age assurance
Experience leading cross-disciplinary efforts across engineering, design, art and UX
Experience and comfort using product and delivery data to inform and drive decisions

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

* Solid working knowledge of UK employment law and comfort navigating multi-jurisdictional complexity
* Calm under pressure, decisive in ambiguity, and confident challenging senior stakeholders
* Genuinely motivated by high-performance cultures — you see hiring bar, performance, and accountability as business priorities, not HR ones

## Your Mission

Job Title: Information Security Project Manager

Reports to: Director of Technical Operations  
Location: UK / Estonia / US (remote-friendly within these regions)

Role purpose

The Information Security Project Manager is responsible for coordinating and driving the company’s information security activities in a pragmatic, commercially aware way.  
This role exists to manage security-related projects, audits, and customer security interactions so that we stay compliant and credible without blocking sensible business decisions or over-engineering controls.

Scope and context

This role sits within the technology function and partners closely with Technical Operations, Engineering, Product, Legal, and Sales.  
The focus is on governance, coordination, and communication, not on dictating policy in isolation or acting as the final decision-maker on security matters.  
Final risk and tooling decisions sit with the Director of Technical Operations and the broader leadership team; the Information Security Project Manager’s job is to provide clear input, well-reasoned recommendations, and organised execution.

We are a growing SaaS business without PCI, PHI, or highly sensitive PII in scope, and we are not subject to HIPAA or classified/secret information regime – our security approach should be proportionate: strong, credible, and well-documented, but not theatrical or unnecessarily restrictive.

Key responsibilities

ISO 27001 and internal audits

* Plan, coordinate, and execute internal audits and control reviews against ISO 27001 (and related frameworks where relevant).
* Maintain audit schedules, evidence repositories, and action logs so that we are consistently “audit ready” rather than scrambling before assessments.
* Work with control owners across the business to ensure that required processes are in place, understood, and operating in a pragmatic way.
* Track findings and remediation actions, ensuring owners are clear on what needs to be done and by when, and following up to completion.
* Support external ISO 27001 surveillance and recertification audits, including planning, evidence collation, and managing auditor queries.

Security projects and initiatives

* Coordinate discrete security improvement projects (for example, rolling out new security tooling, tightening access controls, or updating key policies).
* Break down security initiatives into clear tasks, owners, and timelines, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.
* Work with Technical Operations and Engineering to ensure technical changes are understood, documented, and reflected in our security posture.
* Help prioritise security work by articulating risk, impact, and effort, while understanding the wider commercial and delivery context.

Customer security, RFPs and RFQs

* Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success to respond to customer security questionnaires, RFPs, RFQs, and due diligence requests.
* Maintain and continuously improve a central library of standard security responses and artefacts (for example, summaries of our controls, certifications, and processes).
* Coordinate input from Technical Operations, Engineering, and Legal where deeper technical or contractual responses are required.
* Attend customer calls when needed to explain our security posture in clear, non-alarmist language and build confidence in our approach.

Security information and communication

* Develop and maintain a clear, concise view of our security posture that can be communicated internally and to customers (for example, how we handle data, access, monitoring, and incident response at a high level).
* Ensure that key facts (such as use of encryption at rest and in transit, SSO capabilities, backup approaches, and incident processes) are understood and kept up to date, even if technical details are owned by others.
* Translate technical explanations from engineers into language suitable for non-technical audiences, including customers and internal stakeholders.
* Help ensure that security-related messages are proportionate, avoiding both complacency and unnecessary drama.

Policies, standards, and pragmatic governance

* Maintain a focused, manageable set of security policies and procedures that reflect how we actually operate.
* Work with policy owners to keep documents current, usable, and aligned to ISO 27001 and customer expectations, avoiding policy sprawl and unnecessary complexity.
* Coordinate periodic reviews of key policies and standards, ensuring changes are communicated and understood.
* Provide recommendations to the Director of Technical Operations on improvements to policies, controls, or tooling, with clear reasoning and trade-offs.

What this role is not

* This is not a “head of security” or ultimate decision-maker role; final go/no-go and tooling decisions sit with the Director of Technical Operations and leadership.
* This is not a role for writing endless policies or blocking change; it is about enabling sensible decisions with good information and structured follow-through.
* This is not a hands-on security engineering or development role, though you will need enough technical understanding to ask good questions and interpret answers.
* This is not an internal “police” function; success is based on collaboration, influence, and clarity, not on authority.

## What You'll Bring To The Role

We’re looking for someone who brings most of the following:

* 3–5 years of experience in information security, compliance, risk, or IT audit within a SaaS or technology environment.
* Hands-on experience with ISO 27001 (or similar frameworks), including audits, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.
* Solid project management skills — planning, tracking progress, managing stakeholders, and communicating clearly.
* Working knowledge of core security concepts such as encryption (at rest/in transit), access control, SSO/identity providers, backup and recovery, logging, and incident response — enough to discuss confidently and know when to bring in a specialist.
* Comfortable engaging directly with customers and auditors, answering questions calmly and credibly.
* Strong writing skills for policies, reports, and customer communications, paired with clear verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

  

Personal qualities

* Pragmatic and commercially aware: able to distinguish between theoretical risk and real-world impact.
* Collaborative, working with teams to find workable solutions rather than simply saying “no”.
* Organised and methodical, keeping track of multiple audits, projects, and requests without dropping details.
* Calm and credible under pressure, especially during audits, customer escalations, or security-related incidents.
* Comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, and highlighting risk while still respecting broader business priorities.

Why this role matters

Done well, this role gives the business confidence that our security posture is robust, evidenced, and well-articulated, without turning security into a blocker for growth.  
It ensures we meet our obligations to customers and auditors, support sales with clear and honest answers, and make security improvements in a deliberate, organised, and commercially sensible way.

### About Lorum

The structural conflict at the centre of correspondent banking is not technological. It is economic. Banks earn revenue from their balance sheets: they lend deposits, capture FX spreads, and hold funds as long as it is rational to do so. Clearing, the act of releasing funds quickly and predictably, competes directly with those economics. An institution designed to lend has a structural incentive to hold deposits; an institution designed to clear has an incentive to release them. When one institution does both, clearing loses. The result is unpredictable settlement, trapped capital, and a correspondent network shrinking by design.

## Why Lorum

Lorum was founded on a different premise: clearing as the business, not a byproduct. The model has been operational since 2023 and grew 55x in 2025, with USD clearing now the majority of volumes alongside a growing treasury offering. We have applied for a U.S. national trust bank charter. The people we hire now will build the clearing and treasury infrastructure it unlocks.

## The role

We are building a dedicated institutional sales team selling into banks and financial institutions, and we are hiring experienced originators to drive new business across mid-sized banks that need reliable access to EUR, GBP and USD clearing and correspondent banking.

This is a hunter role. You will bring an existing network at bank level, generate your own pipeline, and run deals from first conversation to signed agreement and onboarding, with minimal hand-holding. You will be the face of Lorum to prospective respondent banks, positioning our nostro and vostro, clearing, trade finance and correspondent banking capabilities into Treasury, Correspondent Banking and FI teams.

This is a young team and the structure is still moving. Reporting lines and regional ownership will change as we hire senior leaders. If you need a settled org chart, this is not the right time to join.

**We are hiring across a range of seniority.** We advertise this role at Director level because that is where we expect most hires to land, but depending on your experience you may join as **Senior Institutional Sales (L3)** or **Director, Institutional Sales (L4)**. We will tell you where you sit early in the process, not at offer. All of these are individual contributor roles with no direct reports.

If you need an SDR to fill your pipeline, or your background is general SaaS with no payments depth, card payments or consumer fintech, this is not the right role.

## Day-to-day responsibilities

* **Pipeline.** Build and own a self-sourced pipeline of mid-sized banks that need EUR or USD correspondent access. Typically regional and national banks, challenger banks, and banks in emerging or frontier markets.
* **Lead generation.** Self-prospect rather than rely on SDR support, because there is none.
* **Inbound.** Own and qualify correspondent banking leads from the website, referrals and events.
* **Targets.** Build accurate forecasts and carry a total quota of £2m+, with individual deals typically well above £100k ARR.
* **Solution selling.** Lead consultative conversations on how clearing, virtual accounts and FX localise and streamline a customer's payment infrastructure.
* **Relationships.** Run 5+ stakeholder cycles through a strong champion, and build trust with C-level decision makers.
* **Account ownership.** Own handover to implementation and customer success, and make sure clients go live and start generating volumes.
* **Cross-functional.** Feed market insight back to product, compliance and operations.
* **Travel.** Expect to travel around 40% of the time once ramped. This role runs on in-person meetings with banks.

## Success in the first 3 to 12 months

* **By month 3.** Product and ICP fluency, with a self-sourced pipeline already building and no SDR dependency.
* **By month 6.** First qualified opportunities landed, and 5+ stakeholder cycles running through a strong champion.
* **By month 12.** Closing deals well above £100k ARR and contributing meaningfully against a £2m+ quota, with genuine vertical depth.

# Ideal Candidate

## Must Haves

* **Track record.** At least three years selling directly to banks, in correspondent banking, transaction banking, FI sales or trade finance. We are also open to people who have sold other financial products into banks, including core banking and enterprise software, where the buyer was genuinely a bank and you have real payments depth.
* **An extensive network in the banking sector**, particularly in treasury & strategy departments.

The structural conflict at the centre of correspondent banking is not technological. It is economic. Banks earn revenue from their balance sheets: they lend deposits, capture FX spreads, and hold funds as long as it is rational to do so. Clearing, the act of releasing funds quickly and predictably, competes directly with those economics. An institution designed to lend has a structural incentive to hold deposits; an institution designed to clear has an incentive to release them. When one institution does both, clearing loses. The result is unpredictable settlement, trapped capital, and a correspondent network shrinking by design.

## Why Lorum

Lorum was founded on a different premise: clearing as the business, not a byproduct. The model has been operational since 2023 and grew 55x in 2025, with USD clearing now the majority of volumes alongside a growing treasury offering. # **Sales Operations Manager**

**Reports To:** Head of Revenue Operations  
**Job Level:** Senior Individual Contributor  
**Location:** London, UK  
**Role Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Salary:** Up to £65,000 DOE

##### Role Closes: Midnight 14 October 2026

*The Sales Operations Manager owns the day-to-day operating rhythm of Lunio’s commercial teams: the reporting, process, systems hygiene and deal governance that keep Sales, Marketing and Customer Success running consistently across the US and ROW regions.*

*You will translate the framework into a live process, clean data and reporting the business trusts, and you will be the first point of contact for the commercial teams when something in that system needs fixing.*

*This is a hands on, delivery focused role with broad ownership and a wide internal audience. It suits someone who would rather build a process properly than fix the same problem twice, and who is comfortable holding reps and managers to an operational standard.*

### You'll make a great Sales Operations Manager at Lunio if you have experience with:

**Pipeline, Forecasting & Reporting:**

● Own and maintain the GTM dashboards, pipeline pacing reporting and forecast reporting used by all commercial regions.

● Run the weekly and monthly forecast cadence, chasing inputs and flagging risk ahead of reviews.

● Track funnel and pipeline health metrics, and surface movement, slippage and coverage gaps early.

● Investigate variance between forecast and actuals, and explain what drove it.

**Deal Desk & Commercial Governance:**

● Run the deal desk: pricing approvals, discount thresholds, quote and contract workflow.

● Review non-standard terms and structures before they reach signature, escalating where needed.

● Maintain the approval matrix and ensure it is followed consistently across both regions.

● Keep closed-won handover to Customer Success clean and on time.

**CRM & Systems Administration:**

**●** Own Salesforce data quality, field governance and day-to-day configuration requests.

● Manage the HubSpot to Salesforce handoff, lead routing and duplicate management.

● Support the wider commercial stack, including Gong and enrichment tooling

● Write clear requirements for larger platform changes and test them before release.

**Sales Process & Enablement Support:**

● Document and embed sales process, qualification standards and pipeline management expectations.

● Onboard new commercial hires onto systems, process and reporting.

● Maintain playbooks, templates and process documentation as the business changes.

● Act as first-line support for reps and managers on systems and process questions.

**Planning, Territories & Commissions:**

● Support annual and half-year planning, including territory design and account prioritisation.

● Administer commission plans: calculation, validation, query resolution and payroll handoff.

● Maintain quota, target and headcount data in the reporting layer.

**Data & Decision Support:**

● Produce reporting and analysis for QBRs, executive reviews and board updates.

● Answer ad hoc commercial questions with analysis rather than opinion.

● Keep definitions and metrics consistent with the wider revenue reporting framework.

### **What does a successful Sales Operations Manager look like at Lunio?**

● Solid experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations or Commercial Operations in B2B SaaS: you have run this day to day, not just contributed to it.

● Strong hands-on Salesforce skills: reports, dashboards, flows, data management and change requests and an understanding of how configuration decisions affect reporting integrity.

● A track record of improving forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene in a team that was not doing it well before you arrived.

● Comfortable being the only person in the seat: you can prioritise your own week against the commercial calendar without close direction.

● Credible with both VP level commercial leaders and reps on the ground, and willing to hold the line on process when appropriate.

### **You will thrive in this role if...**

* You have supported sales teams across more than one region or time zone, and you know how to keep a single process working for two teams that do things slightly differently.
* You are comfortable in a scale up. The playbook is half written, priorities move, and some of what you inherit will need rebuilding rather than tidying.
* You know your way around the wider stack beyond CRM: HubSpot, Gong, Redshift, Clay, enrichment tooling, and you are happy learning the parts you have not used.
* You are interested in where AI and automation can take repetitive operational work off the team, and realistic about where they cannot.
* You like being the person people come to. A good share of this role is unblocking someone else quickly and well, then making sure the same thing does not block them again.

### Why Lunio?

* Genuine Hybrid Working
* 35 days annual leave including bank holidays
* £1000 one off home office budget
* £500 per year wellbeing budget
* £1000 per year Learning & Development Budget
* Flexible working
* Growing Scale-Up with space for you to grow with it!

This is a varied and multifaceted role, which will execute on several core processes and projects that support the delivery of global people strategy. This role will work closely with the UK Senior People Partner, the Shared Services leadership team, UK Specialisms leadership team, Senior People Partner and People Partner.

Delivery of the Global People Strategy:

### We are looking for a Senior Associate specialising in Group Tax for our Tax and Reward group.

## About Macfarlanes

Macfarlanes is a pre-eminent law firm that serves a global client base in Private Capital, Private Wealth, M&A and Disputes. Personal connection, an entrepreneurial spirit and a commitment to excellence are at the heart of our firm. These values drive our ability to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients.

We are big enough to undertake the most complex and demanding mandates yet small enough to know each other well and to be agile, adapting to the needs of our clients. We seek to strengthen the firm by recruiting talented people from all backgrounds who want to build long-lasting and impactful careers with us. Our culture is challenging and supportive, creating an environment where individuals can thrive.

## What this means for you

As an experienced Associate, you will focus on sophisticated, hands-on client advisory work within a collaborative, Partner-led team. You will run matters with genuine autonomy, work at the heart of complex client engagements and help deliver high-quality advice as part of a team that uniquely combines corporate tax and private client expertise. Macfarlanes is the only UK firm ranked Band 1 by Chambers for both corporate tax and private client tax.

You will work alongside Partners and colleagues who value technical excellence, and your work will be recognised for its quality and depth. You will be trusted to manage and deliver on complex matters, building strong relationships with clients and colleagues while playing a substantive role in delivering practical, high-quality advice.

A significant proportion of our work involves advising UK and international privately owned groups on cross-border structuring, multi-jurisdictional tax risk management and international tax developments. This is sophisticated, multi-jurisdictional work involving collaboration with specialist advisers in overseas jurisdictions and close engagement with clients and their wider advisory teams.

Your ongoing professional development will be supported by the breadth and complexity of the work, while you will also contribute actively to the team’s knowledge base. Our culture is collaborative and collegiate, with colleagues sharing expertise across the group and contributing to the development of our collective technical knowledge.

You will be part of a close-knit, supportive team focused on delivering outstanding advisory work for clients. Your expertise and contribution will be genuinely valued, and you will work with colleagues who care deeply about the quality of the advice we provide.

## Practice overview

Our Tax & Reward practice consists of nine partners, four Senior Counsels, 14 Senior Associates, 26 Associates, eight trainee solicitors and three Senior Knowledge Lawyers.

Our Tax & Reward group is rated as one of the leading tax advisory practices in the City. The group provides integrated tax advice for UK and international privately owned groups, combining corporate tax and private client expertise. Clients are often founder-led or family-controlled and face distinct tax, structuring and governance challenges. As with any tax practice in a City law firm, a proportion of our work is transaction-based, supporting corporate, financing, real estate and investment fund transactions, while a substantial and increasing part of our practice involves giving free-standing tax advice to clients of the group.

## The role

The successful candidate will undertake a broad range of high-quality work across the tax practice. Core responsibilities will include:

* Ability to perform at a high level on complex advisory matters for group and international clients, across a wide range of UK and cross-border tax issues. This includes advising on tax-efficient structuring of domestic and international operations, group reorganisations, demergers, returns of value and ownership restructuring, as well as planning and strategy for international tax developments.
* **Client Management:** Delivering excellent client service and managing matters end-to-end (with appropriate delegation), operating with minimal supervision and acting as a trusted point of contact for clients. You will work directly with high-value private groups and their wider advisory teams on sophisticated, often multi-jurisdictional, engagements – including matters involving corporate tax, employment tax and personal tax dimensions.
* **Technical Excellence:** Producing high-quality, well-reasoned tax advice across a range of advisory matters, including residence and domicile issues, governance across jurisdictions, transfer pricing, diverted profits tax, and multi-jurisdictional tax risk management. The role also involves working alongside our private client teams on succession planning, estate and inheritance tax strategy for founders and families, and multi-generational transitions.
* **Team Development:** Playing a material role in the development of junior associates by leading and supervising on client matters, sharing technical expertise, and actively contributing to the team's knowledge base, collective expertise and training programme.

This job description encompasses the main duties of the role and is by no means exhaustive. It is anticipated that duties may vary from time to time according to the needs of the practice area.

## The candidate

We are seeking a Senior Associate to join Macfarlanes' Tax team, working within the group and international tax practice led by Greg Price and Sarah Ling. This is a highly technical role requiring a well-rounded individual with significant advisory experience across a broad range of tax matters.

* minimum of five years' PQE or equivalent post training professional experience;
* a broad spectrum of tax advisory experience; and
* demonstrated ability to manage client matters and effectively supervise and delegate to associates and trainees.

The ideal candidate will bring substantial experience in a senior capacity within one or more of the following environments:

* **Government:** HMRC or HM Treasury, with a focus on international tax policy and large business matters.
* **Professional Services:** A Big 4 or other leading accountancy firm, operating at Senior Manager level or above within a recognised international tax advisory practice. Candidates should have worked predominantly on international tax advisory matters and/or corporate M&A transactions, rather than compliance or audit engagements.
* **Legal:** A reputable law firm, where they will have gained significant responsibility and exposure to high-quality, complex international tax work.

## Application screening

Any offer of employment with us is subject to our pre-employment checks which are conducted by a third-party screening provider. These may include but are not limited to your professional and academic qualifications, any criminal records and employment references. These checks will be initiated with your consent and your offer will be subject to the successful completion of these checks.

## Our commitment to inclusion

Inclusion is one of our key priorities and it is a goal we are actively working towards. We believe that an inclusive, forward-thinking culture is intrinsically important and enables us to provide innovative solutions to our clients.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, bringing different perspectives and experiences, making Macfarlanes an exciting and stimulating place to work. We seek to recruit the best candidates, regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, social or economic background, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic.

As part of this commitment, we will ask you certain diversity data questions. We would really appreciate you and/or your recruiter completing these questions when submitting an application to Macfarlanes as this data enables us to measure our progress and identify any actions needed to continue to support an inclusive culture. This data is anonymised to maintain the privacy of applicants. If you have any questions relating to how this data is used, please contact a member of the recruitment team.

Should you require any adjustments during the application and/or interview process, please do not hesitate to inform your recruiter or a member of the recruitment team. Please note, the job description is available in other accessible formats (for example, large print)

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to disabled applicants who best meet the essential criteria for the role. If you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme, please email the recruitment team at recruitment@macfarlanes.com.

Magnopus is seeking a Senior Graphics Engineer to help build, scale, and optimise our OKO Unreal Engine plugin and studio-facing Unreal pipelines in the UK.

Working primarily on OKO, our real-time, cross-reality collaboration platform, while also supporting Unreal development across our Studio projects, you'll play a central role in shaping the rendering fidelity and creator workflows that define the  experiences we create. This is an opportunity to shape the Unreal experience for a product at the heart of Magnopus' Connected Spaces Platform, influencing the workflows used by creators across web, mobile, XR, and future platforms.

You'll join an established, talented team as a senior Unreal engineer, providing technical leadership across the discipline. While you'll help shape technical direction and mentor those around you, this is a hands-on engineering role rather than a people management position. You'll be solving practical rendering and tooling challenges for a long-term product ecosystem, building technology that evolves over years rather than shipping individual game titles. You'll translate complex rendering requirements into stable, high-performance runtime solutions that look great on everything from VR headsets to web browsers, while creating the tools that allow other developers and artists to move fast.

We're looking for someone equally comfortable designing an editor workflow in the morning and tracking down a rendering bug through Unreal's RHI that afternoon.

### What you'll do

* Own key graphics initiatives across the platform, including asset compatibility, lighting, shader and material workflows, and emerging rendering techniques.
* Design and build solutions for runtime asset translation and cross-platform content workflows.
* Design, extend, and implement custom Unreal Editor tools, UI extensions, and automated asset pipelines to accelerate content creation.
* Tackle low-level graphics, optimisation, and profiling challenges to improve rendering performance and visual fidelity across a range of target hardware.
* Set the technical bar for the Unreal team through architecture decisions, robust C++ code, and active code reviews.
* Work directly with the teams building OKO's other clients (web, mobile) and cloud services to ensure the Unreal experience is world-class.
* Help raise the overall capability of the team through knowledge sharing, documentation, and technical guidance.

### What will help you succeed in this role

* Significant professional experience developing in C++ within Unreal Engine, with a deep understanding of the engine's codebase and runtime systems.
* Strong graphics and rendering programming foundations, with hands-on experience working within Unreal's rendering code (including the RHI), shader development, and GPU performance profiling.
* Experience building, maintaining, or extending Unreal Editor tools, workflows, or pipelines that other developers or artists have relied on.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical rendering or tooling challenges to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* A collaborative mindset and a genuine interest in mentoring peer developers and sharing knowledge across disciplines.
* A track record of creating clarity and driving technical progress within a fast-moving product environment.

### Even better if you also have

* Experience with runtime asset loading and asset interchange technologies (such as glTF/GLB or USD).
* Experience with real-time replication, multiplayer, or real-time synchronisation.
* Experience building, maintaining, or distributing Unreal Engine plugins.
* Contributions to open-source software (our underlying Connected Spaces Platform is open source).

### We don't expect anyone to tick every box above

If you believe you could be successful in the role and are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of real-time, cross-reality collaboration at Magnopus, we'd love to hear from you.

£60,000 - £65,000 a year

Where you join within this range will depend on your experience, the level you're hired at and internal salary alignment.

### About Magnopus

Magnopus is an experience-focused technology company founded by a team of Oscar-winning artists, designers and engineers from the worlds of film, games and immersive media.

We create experiences that bring together storytelling, creativity and technology in new ways — from immersive attractions and interactive installations to virtual production, spatial computing, AI-powered experiences and emerging technologies. Our work helps some of the world's most recognisable brands and organisations connect with audiences in ways that weren't previously possible.

We've built experiences for millions of people around the world and continue to explore what's possible at the intersection of creativity, technology and human connection.

Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
About Neko Health
Neko Health is a Swedish healthcare technology company founded in 2018 by Hjalmar Nilsonne and Daniel Ek. Our mission is to redesign healthcare by shifting the focus from reactive treatment to proactive and preventive care.
We are building a new kind of healthcare experience designed to help people stay ahead of their health. By combining medical expertise with breakthrough technology, we make it possible to quickly and non-invasively gather a broad picture of a person's health and deliver clear insights within minutes.
Headquartered in Stockholm and New York, Neko Health offers the Neko Body Scan experience across Europe and the US, supported by a growing team of people working to transform how healthcare is delivered.
Why this role exists
Legal, Finance and People are what let Neko operate, hire and stay compliant as it scales, and Product & Technology is the largest, most complex function at HQ. These aren't the same kind of problem. Each function sits at a different stage of maturity, and this role isn't about pulling them into one shape. It's about moving fluidly between genuinely different disciplines, bringing the right kind of people practice to each, rather than defaulting to a single playbook.
This is one of the most senior People roles at HQ outside the Global People Lead itself. It suits a senior level HR operator who's genuinely comfortable holding several different kinds of problem at once, and who brings real depth in organisational design, workforce planning, strategy and culture, genuine command of each rather than surface-level familiarity.
What you'll do
Own the people agenda across Corporate Functions and partners with the Global People lead on parts of the Product & Tech organisation
Lead workforce planning and organisational design across Legal, Finance, People, (and support to parts of the Product & Technology teams) role clarity, resourcing decisions and structural recommendations tailored to each function's stage
Meet each function on its own terms, building where a function is still finding its shape, optimising where it's stable, rather than applying one approach everywhere
Build genuine partnership with the leaders who run each of these teams, calibrating the relationship to what each one needs
Be the strategic partner to senior leadership
Serve as the primary strategic partner across Legal, Finance, People and some of the Product & Technology teams, translating business strategy into people priorities, programmes and operating plans for each function
Coach and challenge leaders on the decisions that shape the organisation they'll be running next year, thinking a step ahead of today's priorities
Bring sound judgement and discretion to the most sensitive people matters across all four functions
Champion Neko's culture and Vitals
Partner with leaders across Legal, Finance, People and parts of the Product & Technology to embed Neko's cultural Vitals into how their teams actually operate, day to day
Help leaders translate the Vitals into practical behaviours and decisions across genuinely different functions
Build the rituals and feedback loops that keep culture genuinely lived as each function matures at its own pace
Drive talent management across Corporate Functions and Product & Tech
Working in partnership with the Growth & Engagement team to drive leadership development, performance and engagement for the leadership population across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology
Advise on compensation, mobility and promotions in partnership with Reward & Enablement, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness across genuinely different functions
Lead change and manage risk
Lead and sponsor change initiatives that affect structure or operating model in any of these functions, owning scope, timeline, stakeholder engagement and change readiness from start to finish
Manage employee relations matters across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology, working directly with Legal colleagues and specialist counsel to resolve issues with discretion and confidentiality
Spot risk early, whether that's capacity strain in Legal or Finance, or Product & Technology's pace outstripping its structure
Drive organisational design and workforce planning
Use workforce and org data to shape decisions ahead of need
Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that turn data into clear, decision-ready recommendations
Put data and AI to work in how the people agenda runs day to day, sharper decisions, less manual effort
Bring the right practice to functions at different stages
Recognise that Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology each need different structures, rhythms and support, and build accordingly
Turn central People programmes into practice that fits each function's actual culture and maturity
Experience evaluating how AI informs talent decisions and org design, bringing the judgement to design with AI as a genuine participant in how roles and structures should look, actively shaping the work itself.
What you bring
Deep, hands-on experience across organisational design, workforce planning, people strategy and culture, genuine depth in all four, built through direct ownership rather than generalist HRBP exposure
10+ years in senior HR Business Partner, People Partner, or People/HR leadership roles, including ownership of the people agenda across genuinely different functions at Director level or above
Experience owning leadership development and performance calibration outcomes for a senior leadership population
A track record of personally leading change initiatives end to end: scope, timeline, and stakeholder engagement
A genuine passion for culture and values, with experience helping leaders embed them into how their teams actually work
A track record of partnering with and influencing senior functional leaders on complex, high-stakes organisational decisions, operating with genuine autonomy as an independent decision-maker
Comfort holding functions at very different stages of maturity at once, adapting approach rather than applying one framework to all
Fluent with people data and actively using AI in your own work
Working knowledge of employment law relevant to Neko's HQ locations, with the judgement to know when to bring in specialist expertise
About Titles at Neko
We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market-facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.
Hiring Process
Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews, culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

## We're hiring for a Data Protection Administrator to support our growing Technology team!

To support our growth in the UK and Ireland, we're seeking a dedicated Data Protection Administrator to ensure compliance with the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You will be responsible for managing and maintaining our data protection policies, procedures, and records, as well as providing advice and guidance to staff and stakeholders on data protection matters. You will also handle data subject access requests, data breach incidents, and data protection impact assessments.

## We're looking for someone with:

* A thorough knowledge and understanding of the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and the EU GDPR, as well as other relevant laws and regulations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data protection concepts to different audiences
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess and mitigate data protection risks
* High attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* A minimum of two years of experience in data protection or a similar role
* A certification in data protection, such as the BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection, the IAPP Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), or the ISACA Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE), is desirable but not essential

## Using these skills, you'll be:

* Developing, implementing, and reviewing data protection policies, procedures, and processes in line with the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and the EU GDPR
* Monitoring and auditing the compliance of our data processing activities with the data protection legislation and our internal policies
* Performing data protection due diligence requirements reviews on new business acquisitions
* Conducting data mapping exercises and classifying data to identify areas of risk and ensure appropriate protection measures are in place
* Overseeing and conducting DPIAs to assess and mitigate risks associated with data processing activities
* Conducting and overseeing Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for new projects, systems, or processes involving the processing of personal data
* Providing training and awareness to staff and stakeholders on data protection principles, rights, and obligations
* Acting as the main point of contact for data protection queries and issues, both internally and externally
* Evaluating and managing data protection compliance of third-party vendors and partners
* Managing and responding to data subject access requests, data breach incidents, and data protection impact assessments in a timely and effective manner
* Preparing and delivering regular reports on data protection activities, compliance status, and incidents to senior management
* Liaising with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) and other relevant authorities as required

# Principal or Senior in vitro Disease Biologist

Category: 
Research

Location: 

Oxford, South East, GB

**Your impact starts here**

As Principal or Senior *in vitro* Disease Biologist, you will turn complex human biology into clear insights that guide drug discovery decisions. Working in the Target Identification & Maturation team, you will drive translational science that connects cardiometabolic disease understanding, human-relevant models and multi-modal data to the discovery and progression of new drug targets and molecules.

**What you’ll bring**

We are looking for an experienced *in vitro* scientist who can combine disease area, experimental, and analytical expertise to generate robust evidence and guide decision-making for drug discovery. You will bring scientific and technical depth, sound judgement and the ability to influence effectively in a collaborative, global research environment.

* A PhD or Master’s degree in Metabolic or Cardiovascular biology, Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology, Pharmacology, or a related discipline.
* Experience in an industry drug discovery, translational research or biotechnology setting.
* Demonstrated experience in developing translational human cell-based cardiometabolic disease models, incorporating functional, imaging and omics-based experimental readouts
* Experience in developing automation-friendly functional genomics- and chemical-based experimental screening workflows, applying Design of Experiment (DoE) principles, and generating reproducible high-quality FAIR data and outputs.
* Strong capability in integrating and interpreting multi-modal data to support target discovery, molecule characterisation and project decisions, including hands-on use of digital/AI tools.
* A track record of leading scientific projects, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, communicating complex findings and mentoring colleagues.
* Experience in novel drug target diligence and evidence package generation is desirable.

You can distinguish robust, decision-relevant evidence from exploratory findings and communicate conclusions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. You build trusted relationships, remain curious about emerging science and actively contribute to high scientific standards.

**What you’ll do**

As Principal or Senior *in vitro* Disease Biologist, you will help shape scientific strategy and translate biological hypotheses into practical discovery approaches. Working with a high degree of independence, you will combine disease area, experimental, and analytical expertise to generate robust evidence, influence decisions and advance our discovery pipeline.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Applying your knowledge of cardiometabolic physiology and disease pathophysiology to identify innovative human-relevant opportunities for drug target and molecule discovery.
* Designing and implementing translational human cell-based cardiometabolic disease models, incorporating functional, imaging and omics-based experimental readouts.
* Developing automation-friendly functional genomics- and chemical-based experimental screening workflows, applying Design of Experiment (DoE) principles, and generating reproducible high-quality FAIR data and outputs.
* Integrating *in vitro* functional, imaging and multi-omics outputs with other data types - including *in vivo*, *ex* vivo, human genetics, clinical and real-world datasets - using appropriate digital and AI tools, to identify targets, mechanisms and translational signals.
* Leading drug target diligence, developing evidence-based target profiles and presenting clear recommendations that support selection, prioritisation and pipeline progression.

You will also collaborate across scientific disciplines and with external partners, communicate the confidence and limitations of findings, and help colleagues develop through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

This role is open at both Senior and Principal Scientist level, and its scope and impact will be shaped by the level at which you join the team.

**Who you’ll work with**

The Target Identification and Maturation (TIM) department, based within Novo Nordisk Research and Development UK (NNRDUK) in Oxford, UK, is part of Novo Nordisk Global Research. TIM plays a pivotal role in discovering, validating, and advancing novel therapeutic targets and molecules that address unmet patient needs across Novo Nordisk’s research portfolio. Leveraging cutting-edge human biology, advanced experimental platforms, computational approaches, and translational science, the department generates insights that enable target identification, mechanistic understanding, and target maturation towards project initiation. 

Our multidisciplinary teams work across the value chain, integrating *in vitro* and *in silico* capabilities, functional genomics, screening technologies, data science, and disease biology to uncover and de-risk new therapeutic opportunities. While maintaining a strong focus on cardiometabolic diseases, including obesity, type 2 diabetes and related co-morbidities, TIM also supports the exploration of emerging therapeutic areas and novel biological pathways. 

The Oxford research centre thrives on collaboration. We maintain strong partnerships with leading academic institutions, particularly the University of Oxford, as well as biotechnology and technology partners worldwide. As part of a Global Research organization, TIM works closely with colleagues in Denmark, the US, and across Novo Nordisk Global Research to translate scientific discoveries into the next generation of innovative medicines for patients. 

**What you can expect here**

You will join a scientific community where curiosity and patient focus are central to how we work, and where your expertise can help shape important decisions. You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard, while being supported to grow through mentorship, collaboration, and challenging work across therapeutic areas and development stages.

# Backend Tech Lead

Holborn, London

Octopus Money is hiring a Fullstack Tech Lead, with a speciality in Backend development, for one of our fullstack teams.

From a technical perspective, we’re looking for a highly skilled software engineer with a proven track record of delivering quality products.

From a core perspective, we’re looking for someone to lead their team by example - fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement among our development team. Your guidance will empower our team members to excel and contribute their best work.

**The role and opportunity**

The Tech Lead plays a pivotal role in the engineering team, serving as a bridge between technical strategy and execution. Reporting to our Engineering Manager, the Tech Lead is responsible for guiding the technical direction of projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation within the team.  
  
Our backend tech stack is written in Go, using a combination of DynamoDB and Postgres and hosted using AWS. Our frontend is built with React and TypeScript, and our mobile app is built with React Native.

As a Tech Lead you will still spend 60% of your time writing code as part of the product team but you will also have additional responsibilities.

**Day to day you will be responsible for:**

* **Technical Leadership**

+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, ensuring best practices and coding standards are followed
+ Hold developmental 1:1s with reports focusing on career development
+ Line Management of a full stack team, 2 front-end (TypeScript) and 2 back-end (Go) developers
+ Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, working closely with Product and Design Leads

* **Project Management**

+ Drive the execution of projects from conception to delivery, ensuring milestones are met
+ Coordinate with Product Managers to prioritise features and tasks, balancing technical debt and business needs
+ Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies as needed

* **Team Collaboration**

+ Foster a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning within the team
+ Facilitate effective communication between engineers, product stakeholders, and other teams
+ Encourage innovation and experimentation, promoting a culture of adaptability and resilience

* **Code Quality and Review:**

+ Oversee code reviews, providing constructive feedback and guidance to maintain high-quality code
+ Champion software engineering best practices, including test-driven development, code refactoring, and code reviews where appropriate
+ Ensure adherence to coding standards, security guidelines, and compliance requirements

* **Technical Strategy:**

+ Contribute to the development of technical roadmaps and long-term strategies, aligning with business objectives
+ Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities for innovation and improvement
+ Evaluate new tools, frameworks, and technologies, making recommendations for adoption based on technical and business considerations

### **About You**

**Collaborative and a great team player**We’ve built a great team of top performers, and you’ll need to work with others from across the business to identify problems, agree solutions and implement changes.

**Problem solver at heart with an analytical mindset**You should be someone who gets excited by complex problems and can find creative ways to solve them no matter what your level of knowledge and experience with the subject matter. You should be able to digest complexity and develop a plan to move forward, without losing sight of the important details.

**Goal driven and not afraid to get stuck in**We like to set ambitious goals and find creative ways to hit them, even if that means rolling up our sleeves and doing manual tasks before we’ve managed to fully automate them. You should have a bias towards action and getting things done.

**Skills and Experience required**

* 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on back-end development. Go is ideal, but similar typed backend technologies are also welcome
* 1+ years of experience leading engineering teams
* Comfortable with architecting systems
* Comfortable integrating with external APIs and systems
* Proven track record of technical leadership and project management, preferably in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams
* Ideally hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree level in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or comparable experience

**Nice to have**

* Experience with TypeScript and/or React
* Experience with AWS
* Previous Fintech experience
* Previous experience managing engineering teams

**Success looks like this at Octopus Money**

* You can handle ambiguity. You’re comfortable using judgement to create structure and applying first principle thinking
* You’re someone who ‘chases the ball’, rather than just hoping others pick it up. We look for determination, resilience and a healthy dose of optimism
* You thrive in a fast paced environment. You’re open to course correct when needed, and challenge yourself and others to

**About Octopus Money**

🐙 We’re on a mission to become the most recommended financial services business in the UK 🐙

Money shapes every part of life. Yet most people never get the support they need:

* Half of Brits reach retirement age without enough to live the life they want
* Financial stress is a leading cause of poor mental health
* Only 8% of people have access to 1-to-1 financial advice

There’s no shortage of information. What people actually need is clarity, guidance and a plan that makes sense for them.

That’s where we come in.

Octopus Money brings together financial planning, investment expertise and smart technology so people can understand their options and take action with confidence. We help people build a clear plan for their savings, investments and pensions and make investing simple with managed portfolios built by experts. We also support employers who want their teams to feel more secure and in control.

Some people need regulated advice. Others need coaching. Many need both at different points in life. Our service adapts to what each person needs.

We believe everyone deserves money support that works for real life.

**We value people who:**

**Make every conversation matter**  
You care about how you make people feel. You communicate clearly, listen well and build trust with customers and colleagues. You want every interaction to move things forward.

**Move with urgency and focus**  
You like getting stuck in. You care about making progress, not perfection. You stay focused on what matters, learn quickly and find smart ways to keep things moving.

**Own it**  
You take responsibility for your work and the outcomes it creates. You’re comfortable solving problems, making decisions and tackling challenges head on. You hold yourself to a high standard and want to make a real impact.

**What’s in it for you**

In return for your contribution we offer a base salary of £90,000 - £100,000 DOE + benefits

We want people to grow here, to feel supported and to feel proud of the impact they make.

**Where we work**

We believe in the power of in-person collaboration three days a week, but we also know people need flexibility. We give you 6 weeks a year to work away from the office when you need to; whether you want to work abroad, or just need to be at home.

**How we work**

Culture starts with the right behaviours at the top. Our leaders are hands on, get stuck in, and see no job as too small. Across the business, we try to strip out unnecessary process wherever we can: people don’t need to join meetings where they’re not needed, and we challenge our teams to regularly question what’s draining their time. We talk openly about ‘stumbles of the week’, and celebrate each other with Inkspiration awards.

We want everyone in our business to see the value of their personal impact, and that’s reflected in individual bonuses. And, we’re an employee owned business, with a Share Incentive Plan.

* amicable is building a better way to go through divorce
* Aurora is rethinking education
* Seccl is building the fintech infrastructure behind modern investing
* Octopus Investments and Octopus Capital back the ideas and businesses of tomorrow

We want people to grow here, to feel supported and to feel proud of the impact they make!

* Performance-based bonus
* Company pension
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced parental leave
* Birthday day off
* A supportive team who care about what they do
* The chance to help people improve their lives

# Project Controls Engineer

**29th September, 2026**

**Project Controls Engineer**

Location: Great Yarmouth

Company: ODE Asset Management Limited (ODE)

Contract: Permanent | Full Time

**About ODE Asset Management:**

ODE Asset Management Limited (ODE) is an established Asset Management and Operations Support provider with offices in Aberdeen and Great Yarmouth. As part of the DORIS Group, we deliver engineering, project management and operational support services across the UK energy sector, supporting the safe, reliable and efficient operation of critical offshore and onshore assets.

Our success is built on technical excellence, strong operational governance and a commitment to safety, quality and continuous improvement..

**About the Project Controls Engineer Role**:

We are looking for an experienced and analytical Project Controls Engineer to join our Logistics and Planning team based in Great Yarmouth.

This is a varied role providing integrated cost control, planning, forecasting and performance management support across a portfolio of ODE client contracts and projects.

Working closely with Operations Managers, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics and Finance, you will help maintain robust project controls processes that provide clear visibility of current performance, emerging trends, future workload, cost exposure and schedule risk.

The role will support both ongoing Duty Holder / COMAH site operations and discrete projects across ODE’s wider client portfolio, providing accurate and timely management information to support effective decision-making.

**Key responsibilities include:**

**Cost Control**

* Developing and maintaining project and operational budgets, forecasts and cost reports for assigned contracts.
* Monitoring actual expenditure, commitments, accruals and forecast expenditure against approved budgets.
* Producing monthly cost reports, including variance analysis, forecast outturn and commentary on key movements.
* Maintaining Estimate at Completion (EAC) and forecast cost projections, identifying emerging cost pressures and opportunities.
* Reviewing purchase orders, invoices and commitments to ensure expenditure is correctly allocated and reflected within client forecasts.
* Working closely with Finance, Supply Chain and Operations Managers to reconcile financial information and ensure reporting accuracy.
* Supporting annual budget cycles, client forecasting exercises and financial reporting for governance meetings.
* Supporting the financial assessment of scope changes, variations and additional client requirements.

**Planning & Scheduling**

* Developing, maintaining and administering integrated operational and project schedules using Primavera P6 and other planning systems as appropriate.
* Working with Operations, Engineering, Logistics and other disciplines to capture planned activities, milestones, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Monitoring actual progress against approved plans and baselines and identifying schedule variances, constraints and potential conflicts.
* Undertaking schedule reviews and supporting the development of recovery or mitigation plans.
* Integrating client, contractor and supplier activities into ODE operational plans.
* Identifying key interfaces and dependencies across operations, procurement, engineering, marine, aviation and other project activities.
* Supporting short, medium and long-term operational planning and producing lookaheads and milestone reports.

**Project Controls & Performance Reporting**

* Providing integrated cost and schedule reporting to Operations Managers.
* Supporting the identification and assessment of changes to scope, cost and schedule.
* Developing dashboards, KPIs and management information to clearly communicate project and contract performance.
* Analysing trends and performance data to identify emerging issues before they adversely affect cost, schedule or operational delivery.
* Supporting client-specific project controls procedures, reporting calendars and governance requirements.
* Contributing to monthly and quarterly performance reviews.
* Using Excel, Power BI and other digital tools to improve the quality, efficiency and presentation of management information.
* Supporting continuous improvement of project controls processes, systems and reporting tools.

**Skills, Experience and qualities we are looking for**:

**Essential**

* Degree, HNC/HND, professional qualification or demonstrable equivalent experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
* Previous experience in a project controls, cost control, planning or similar analytical role.
* Strong Microsoft Excel capability.
* Experience preparing budgets, forecasts, cost reports and management information.
* Experience developing or maintaining project or operational schedules.
* Strong commercial, financial, analytical and numerical capability.
* Excellent attention to detail with a strong focus on data integrity.
* Strong planning, prioritisation and organisational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple contracts, projects and competing priorities.
* Confident communicator with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong written communication and report-writing skills.
* Proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to work with limited supervision.

**Desirable**

* Experience within oil & gas, offshore energy, renewables, engineering or another safety-critical industry.
* Working knowledge of Primavera P6.
* Experience using Power BI or similar reporting/dashboard tools.
* Understanding of project controls principles including baselining, forecasting, change control, progress measurement and variance analysis.
* Experience working within a client-facing environment.
* Knowledge of procurement, contracting and commercial processes.
* Awareness of Duty Holder/Operator environments and offshore operations.

**Why Join ODE?**

At ODE, you’ll join a collaborative and experienced team supporting a diverse portfolio of operational assets and projects across the energy sector.

This role provides an opportunity to work across the full project controls discipline rather than focusing solely on cost or planning. You’ll work closely with operational, engineering, logistics, supply chain and finance teams, providing the information and analysis that directly supports project and operational decision-making.

In return, we offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including:

* A competitive salary
* 22 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
* Company pension scheme
* Company performance-related bonus
* Salary sacrifice electric car scheme
* Sick pay
* Life insurance
* Private medical and dental insurance
* Employee Assistance Programme

**How to Apply**:

If you have experience in project controls, cost management or planning and are looking for a varied role supporting both operational assets and projects, we’d like to hear from you.

Please submit your CV together with a covering email or letter outlining:

* Your relevant project controls, cost control and/or planning experience.
* Your experience of budgeting, forecasting, scheduling and performance reporting.
* Why you are interested in joining ODE as a Project Controls Engineer.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application.
